  • Define and lead the overarching testing strategy by architecting accurate unit and component testing frameworks using network emulation tools to drastically reduce NPI cycle times and prevent production rollbacks.
  • Build sophisticated software to interface with global software-defined networking (SDN) controllers, translating high-level network intent into device configurations using industry-standard protocols like gRIBI, gNMI, and RPCs.
  • Evaluate the current inefficiencies, complexities, and flaws in network systems, and propose designs, software, and processes to improve them.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
  • 5 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

title: Finance Subject Matter Expert, AI Models, Evaluations and Data, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
DeepMind is building frontier financial reasoning and agentic capabilities across Gemini and our enterprise agent harnesses. Moving AI from a generalist research assistant to an agent that can autonomously complete financial workflows requiresmore than raw pre-training scale - it requires deep domain mechanics embedded directly into how models are post-trained, how agent harnesses and tools are architected, and how evaluations measure real-world finance.

As a Finance Subject Matter Experts (SME), you will work with models, evaluations, and post-training data in the following three Finance domains -

  • Quantitative Trading
  • Corporate Finance - specifically with experience across FP&A, Audit and Tax
  • Alternative Asset Management

Unlike traditional advisory roles that stop at high-level feedback or static prompt writing, you will sit directly in the model development loop alongside Research Scientists, Post-Training Engineers, and Product Managers. You will prioritize differentiated financial workflows, design end-to-end financial benchmarks, construct atomic and deterministic grading rubrics, diagnose multi-step agent trajectories, repair near-miss model reasoning traces, design verifiable reward signals, and co-build domain-specific agent skills.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.


We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate the AI's step-by-step process across calculations, ledger searches, and code to pinpoint quantitative or accounting errors.
  • Create realistic financial tasks (e.g., valuations, backtests, audits) and write "gold-standard" examples to correct model near-misses.
  • Build complex prompts featuring vague instructions, GAAP/non-GAAP differences, and conflicting estimates to test AI resilience.
  • Create pass/fail checklists for deliverables and draft deceptive, polished-but-wrong answers to stress-test automated graders.
  • Teach the AI to efficiently use core financial tools (SQL, etc) and categorize error patterns into reusable templates.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, quantitative fields, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of institutional finance experience in investigative, modeling-intensive roles (Quantitative Trading, Corporate Finance, or Alternative Asset Management).
  • Experience with frontier LLMs, coding agents, or AI evaluation pipelines, including structured prompts and tool-use traces.
  • Experience identifying flaws in AI-generated financial models, backtests, or memos, and translating these errors into generalizable grading rules.

Preferred qualifications:

  • CFA, CPA, MBA, JD, Master of Financial Engineering (MFE), or an advanced quantitative degree in Finance, Computer Science, Math, or Economics.
  • Background building benchmarks, rubrics, or SFT/RLHF pipelines at AI labs, fintechs, or quantitative teams.
  • Domain-specific excellence in Python and SQL (Quant) or advanced, macro-free spreadsheet software and Python/SQL (Alternative Asset Management/Corporate Finance).
  • Familiarity with market data feeds, SEC EDGAR, Capital IQ, FactSet, Bloomberg, ERP/EPM, and tax/audit platforms.

title: Quản lý tiếp thị sản phẩm, nhóm Tiếp thị Google Ads (Nhiều ngôn ngữ)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Cho dù phụ trách một sản phẩm tiêu dùng (như Gmail, Tìm kiếm, Maps, Chrome, Android) hay một sản phẩm kinh doanh (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), bạn đều đóng góp vào một trải nghiệm tiếp thị hoàn chỉnh qua việc dẫn dắt mọi khía cạnh của hành trình sản phẩm. Bắt đầu từ khâu định vị, đặt tên, phân tích khả năng cạnh tranh, ưu tiên tính năng cho đến truyền thông đối ngoại, bạn sẽ góp phần định hình sản phẩm và giúp tăng trưởng số lượng người tiêu dùng. Theo đó, bạn sẽ làm việc với một phòng ban liên ngành trong các lĩnh vực bán hàng, truyền thông doanh nghiệp, pháp chế, quản trị trang web, phát triển sản phẩm, kỹ thuật, cùng nhiều lĩnh vực khác. Khi đảm nhiệm vai trò này, bạn sẽ tham gia vào việc xây dựng chiến lược tiếp thị sản phẩm từ đầu đến cuối.

Khi đảm nhiệm vai trò này, bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm dẫn dắt các sáng kiến của Google nhằm thúc đẩy nền kinh tế số phát triển, đảm bảo sự an toàn cho người dùng và củng cố vị thế thương hiệu của Google trong hệ sinh thái kỹ thuật số tại Đông Nam Á và các thị trường mới nổi ở Nam Á (SAF) cũng như đối với những người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn tại quốc gia này. Bạn sẽ nắm vững hệ sinh thái kỹ thuật số ở thị trường SAF và phối hợp với nhóm để xác định những sáng kiến phù hợp sẽ mang lại tác động tích cực cho hoạt động kinh doanh (B2B và B2C) và danh tiếng. Bạn sẽ ra mắt các chương trình, xây dựng mối quan hệ đối tác và tạo chiến dịch tiếp thị nhằm đưa những ý tưởng này vào thực tế. Đây là một vai trò năng động và mang tinh thần làm chủ, đòi hỏi nhiều kỹ năng về mảng tiếp thị/xây dựng thương hiệu, khả năng lãnh đạo vận hành mạnh mẽ cũng như khả năng thúc đẩy mối quan hệ đối tác bền vững cả nội bộ lẫn bên ngoài.

Hiểu rõ người dùng. Hiểu rõ giải pháp. Kết nối người dùng và giải pháp. Về bản chất, hoạt động tiếp thị tại Google bắt đầu từ công nghệ và kết thúc ở người dùng, kết nối cả hai theo những cách độc đáo. Công việc của chúng tôi là chứng minh cách sản phẩm của Google có thể giải quyết vấn đề trên thế giới: từ những điều nhỏ bé thường nhật cho đến thách thức lớn lao, từ những điều bình thường đến những vấn đề có tầm vóc vĩ đại. Đồng thời, chúng tôi tiếp cận hoạt động tiếp thị theo cách mà chỉ Google mới làm được – thay đổi cuộc chơi, tái định hình phương tiện, ưu tiên người dùng, và rồi để công nghệ tự chứng tỏ khả năng.

Responsibilities

  • Khám phá thông tin chuyên sâu về người dùng, nhà quảng cáo, người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn và hệ sinh thái quảng cáo kỹ thuật số để hỗ trợ việc lên các sáng kiến và chiến lược truyền thông.
  • Dẫn dắt hoạt động ra mắt sản phẩm và chương trình mới: từ xây dựng khái niệm, lập chiến lược, đến thực thi sáng kiến, bản địa hoá nội dung, tạo dựng quan hệ đối tác, truyền thông, thực hiện kế hoạch và các chiến dịch nâng cao thương hiệu tích hợp. 
  • Thấm nhuần và đưa thương hiệu, sứ mệnh và các giá trị của Google vào thực tiễn bằng một câu chuyện thống nhất xoay quanh cam kết của Google đối với quốc gia này xuyên suốt các sáng kiến được ra mắt.
  • Làm việc sát sao, phối hợp, hướng dẫn và tạo ảnh hưởng đến các phòng ban liên ngành có liên quan để đảm bảo mang lại tác động cao nhất cho thương hiệu Google. Quản lý công ty quảng cáo và đối tác bên ngoài để xây dựng và thực thi các chương trình, đồng thời thực hiện hiệu quả mục tiêu của chiến dịch và mục tiêu kinh doanh.
  • Hỗ trợ truyền đạt thông tin ở cấp lãnh đạo trong bộ phận tiếp thị và với các phòng ban liên ngành khác.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 4 năm kinh nghiệm trong hoạt động tiếp thị, làm việc trong ít nhất một lĩnh vực tiếp thị (cụ thể là tăng trưởng, tiếp thị sản phẩm, tiếp thị thương hiệu, mạng xã hội).
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng tiếng Anh và một trong các ngôn ngữ sau: tiếng Việt, tiếng Thái hoặc tiếng Bahasa Indonesia để hỗ trợ việc quản lý quan hệ khách hàng ở khu vực này.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc tại công ty tiếp thị, công ty quảng cáo hoặc công ty tư vấn quản lý.
  • Hiểu rõ về các sản phẩm của Google và ngành công nghệ.
  • Hiểu rõ về công nghệ, sáng tạo, có khả năng tư duy đột phá và triển khai công việc hiệu quả bằng năng lực lãnh đạo.
  • Có khả năng đạt được mục tiêu đề ra, phát triển và hiểu rõ chiến lược.
  • Xuất sắc trong kỹ năng xác định và giải quyết vấn đề theo chiến lược.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Network Delivery Implementation
descriptionHtml:
As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

As a part of the Network Delivery Implementation team, you will build and operate the future of Google's global network, connecting billions of users to our expanding services and enabling the world's imagination with dependable, universal connectivity. You will own the full network life-cycle in our data centers and metro points of presence, driving continuous reliability, efficiency, and rapid service activation to meet the ever-growing demands of a connected world, with the goal to make connectivity ubiquitous between every machine and every user on the Internet.

You will be a key contributor as a member of the Global Network Delivery team, directly impacting Google's ability to deliver network capacity to its customers. Your role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of network delivery through automation and process innovation. Teamwork, collaboration, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to challenging the status quo are essential for success in this role.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life-cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee QA of installation technicians for rack, stack and installation of networking equipment.
  • Commission and test routers, optical transport equipment, and other network devices in new and existing network nodes across Google's global network.
  • Develop implementation plans and provide technical leadership and guidance during deployment activities.
  • Work closely with project management, network engineering and rest of the engineering team to identify in advance potential problems in network installations, including in the areas of facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management.
  • Maintain network documentation, updating and maintaining network drawings and plans.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Network or Telecom Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in carrier-class environments, with technical experience in both Layer 1 physical infrastructure (DWDM, AC/DC power, OSP/ISP).
  • Experience interpreting and validating deployment packages (including orders and construction specs) to verify design accuracy and escalating discrepancies to engineering partners before installation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in one or more of the following disciplines: Layer 1 optical transmissions systems, layer 3 routing TCP/IP, wireless networking, network design, or operations.
  • Experience identifying recurring errors in deployment packages or specifications and driving feedback loops to improve design accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting, or SQL to query databases and track deployment consistency. Basic Linux experience (ie run commands, move directories).
  • Proven ability to lead technical projects and troubleshoot complex field deployments alongside data center technicians and third party vendors, ensuring installation quality and resolving on-site technical blockers to meet timelines

title: Group Product Manager, Search Content Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In the AI era, users expect Search to effortlessly Answer, Explore, and Address Anything. To meet these rising expectations, our models need the content.

The Search Content Platform (SCP) team builds an AI-first content platform to deliver a comprehensive and trustworthy knowledge source. By acquiring third-party data and organizing disparate modalities—such as text, images, videos, and User-Generated Content—into a seamless whole, we make Search AI experiences rich, helpful, and performant.

Our team's mission is to use AI to revolutionize how we acquire and organize third-party content. As the Group Product Manager for Content Acquisition and Identity, you will manage a team to define the future of Google Search content. You will collaborate with engineering teams in Zurich, Sao Paulo, and Mountain View, and represent the organization to key partners.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the product goal, detailed platform requirements for a horizontal content acquisition platform that accelerates third-party (3P) content acquisition while delivering on critical priority verticals such as Sports and Health.
  • Enable Search to answer billions of user queries daily by innovating on content identity for the AI era and establishing clear, disambiguated, and precise identities for billions of user queries on Search daily.
  • Direct efforts to analyze billions of current and aspirational user queries that lack sufficient content, and prioritize or drive initiatives to bridge these gaps and improve product helpfulness to end users.
  • Discuss your knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process to demonstrate the AI fluency expected in this role.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience balancing consumer reach with infrastructure constraints (cost, latency, and model optimization).
  • Experience in cross-functional leadership, and partnering with teams across organizational boundaries.
  • Familiarity with modern machine learning, LLMs, and foundational models (such as Gemini).

title: Ads Solution Engineer, gTech Agency and Partner Engineering
descriptionHtml:
gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

gTech Ads has established the Agency and Partners (gAP) Organization with a mission to scale gTech's expert services by building a thriving and technically enabled partner ecosystem.

As an Ad Solutions Engineer in the gAP Engineering team, you will be responsible for building and scaling specific tools, platforms, and solutions for our strategic large customer sales (LCS) partners. Through building, implementing and optimizing technical solutions, this team will help agencies and partners achieve their business goals while building long-term tech and marketing capabilities.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Be responsible for proactively identifying and building a series of solutions and best practices for agencies and partners globally.
  • Leverage engineering skills to design and scale complex, cross-product customized solutions to be rolled out to customers globally.
  • Collect requirements, provide guidance, best practices, and innovative solutions to apply ad products and technologies and drive agency/partner and gTech business goals.
  • Develop innovative solutions to the business problems faced by agencies and partners globally.
  • Identify trends and develop new solutions to reach advertisers and drive business goals.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience working with client-side web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or HTTP).
  • 6 years of experience coding with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C++, Python).
  • Experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA or Master's degree in a related technical field.
  • Experience working with Ad tech products such as Ad server, DSPs, DMPs, and web analytics.
  • Experience working in the ad space, first-party data onboarding and activation, measurement and data modeling, video and search advertising.
  • Understanding of engineering solutions built for scale.
  • Effective project management, people management, leadership, problem solving skills, with the ability to formulate data-driven proposal.

title: Software Engineer III, Infrastructure, Google Distributed Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

We are the team building the infrastructure for Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) connected on-premise Anthos clusters. Our platform provides a variety of customers including retail and global telecommunications with a managed k8s platform that is located in their data centers, connected to their private network. We deliver the compute and storage services that support mission-critical workloads for retail customers as well as manufacturing customers including ASML.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Write and test product or system development code.
  • Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
  • Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
  • Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree in an industry setting.
  • 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
  • Experience in a Linux/Unix operating system environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) in cloud environments.
  • Experience in software development using C++ or Go.

title: Administrative Business Partner, APAC Comms
descriptionHtml:
As an Administrative Business Partner, you're at the heart of your team's business operations and activities and the soul that keeps your team moving forward. You anticipate the needs of your managers and team members and help them stay focused on their projects by resolving operational and administrative issues before they arise. You move quickly with the changing environment and are up to date with the latest Google products and services. You also use that knowledge to strategically support your team's projects. In addition to being organized and analytical, you possess the strong business judgment and communication skills needed to interact with a variety of people and job functions.

In this role, you will be an Administrative Business Partner supporting leaders of Asia-Pacific (APAC) Comms team at Google. You will work with a team of communicators.

Administrative jobs at Google are staffed by organized and dependable people driven by a common company goal: to help us accomplish great things. Working behind the scenes, we make a significant impact on the people we support as well as on Google users around the world. We're adept at leading and managing a variety of simultaneous projects, which requires the particular talent of being able to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Act as strategic air traffic control for theleaders daily schedule, strictly prioritizing time against P0 business goals, OKRs, and critical leadership moments. Coordinate seamlessly across multiple executive offices, Google Leads, and external VIPs.
  • Manage complex, high-frequency domestic and international travel itineraries, accommodations, and ground logistics. Prepare detailed travel briefings and proactively resolve multi-time zone scheduling conflicts.
  • Lead end-to-end operational planning for critical moments, executive offsites, meetings, and leadership forums. Provide high-touch support for internal and external engagements.
  • Help to build efficiencies into executive workflows by defining best practices and integrating AI tools. Serve as a culture carrier across the GCPA's Administrative Business Partners (E/ABPs). Support development, and operational standards.
  • Maintain absolute confidentiality and discretion on sensitive business, organizational, and personnel matters. Partner closely with the S and O, GAPP, Marketing REWS, and People Operations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 3 years of administrative experience in a high-tech or international environment working on core administrative tasks (e.g., travel management, expense reports, calendar management, facilities coordination, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 6 years of administrative experience supporting executive-level management in a corporate environment, and managing small-scale projects and events from pre-planning to execution.
  • Experience supporting leaders within global organizations and serving as a project lead from conception to completion.
  • Knowledge of Google and project management practices to solve operational issues.
  • Ability to grow in extremely fast-paced environments, demonstrating high flexibility, adaptability, and autonomous execution.
  • Ability to cultivate strong relationships, leverages perspectives, and communicate effectively across all job functions.

title: Senior Product Manager, Eval Quality, AI Data
descriptionHtml:
Artificial Intelligence is evolving at an unprecedented pace, and AI Agents represent the next frontier. These agents, capable of complex reasoning, tool use, and interacting with dynamic environments, are poised to redefine how we live and work. Ensuring these agents are safe, reliable, and effective is paramount, and that's where evaluations come in.

Evaluations have always been the bedrock of successful AI development. However, the methods used for traditional Large Language Models fall short when it comes to agents. Unlike static models, agents operate in a world of vast possibilities, delivering value through a sequence of actions and interactions.

We need to pioneer new ways of thinking for agent evaluation. Think Waymo online: we must create rich, dynamic simulation environments to test agents against a massive state space, uncovering failure modes and ensuring robust performance across countless scenarios. This isn't just an incremental improvement; it's about defining how the next generation of AI will be validated.

If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and solving some of the most problems in the field, this is your chance. Come join our Evals team, where with products like Everest and EvalHub, we empower GenAI model development across Google. In this role, you will lead the product goal for how Google evaluates AI Agents, ensuring we build the most capable and trustworthy agentic systems in the world.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a first-principles understanding of what makes an evaluation task truly useful—optimizing for coverage, climbability (scaling with compute and data while preserving headroom), discriminability, statistical stability (tight confidence intervals), and zero contamination.
  • Synthesize insights into a holistic product goal and roadmap for Eval Quality.
  • Operate seamlessly across Product Area boundaries between Gemini, AI2, and other partner product areas.
  • Grow in Gemini’s dynamic, fast-moving, research-driven environment where priorities evolve rapidly and Product Managers earn trust by directly contributing to day-to-day execution.

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

  • Deep intuition for evaluation science—understanding what separates a brittle benchmark from a high-signal, climbable, uncontaminated evaluation across specialized verticals (e.g., finance, law, medicine, math, science, and engineering).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the gravitas to align Executive Team Leads, Research Scientists, and VP/SVP leadership across London and US time zones.

We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

title: Staff ML Compiler Engineer, TPU Performance Optimizations
descriptionHtml:

We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stack and TPU compiler for Google first-party teams, and for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) customers.

In this role, you will build the infrastructure powering the world’s most advanced machine learning.You will drive the future of Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) performance. You will design and implement advanced compiler optimizations such as pipelining, prefetching, and fusions to maximize TPU efficiency. You will directly impact internal Alphabet initiatives, including Large Language Model (LLM) development and chip co-design, while empowering external cloud customers. You will collaborate across teams to integrate frameworks like PyTorch and ensure the hardware remains the industry’s premier Machine Learning (ML) platform.The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Responsibilities

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with ML compilers and their internals, experience writing compiler optimization passes.
  • Experience with debugging correctness and performance issues at all levels of the ML Software (SW) stack.
  • Experience with GPU or TPU performance analysis.
  • Comfortable with accelerator Hardware (HW) architectures (TPUs/Graphics Processing Unit (GPUs)).
  • Comfortable debugging correctness and performance issues at all levels of the stack.

  • Collaborate closely with architects, designers, and other teams to drive bug fixes and ensure feature functionality. Contribute to the development of test infrastructure and methodologies to improve validation efficiency and coverage.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience with functional tests for silicon validation (i.e., writing in C, C++ or Python, or similar).
  • 4 years of experience in silicon bring-up, functional validation, characterizing, and qualifying silicon.
  • 4 years of experience in pre-silicon or post-silicon validation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience in hardware and silicon validation.
  • Ability to learn new systems quickly and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to take on technical challenges, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills.

title: Regulatory and Litigation Counsel, Privacy Incidents and Regulatory Investigations
descriptionHtml:
Regulatory Affairs helps the company innovate responsibly and comply with laws around the world. We partner with teams across Global Affairs, Product Areas, and the rest of the company to ensure constructive engagement with governments and regulators while mitigating risk.

As Regulatory and Litigation Counsel, Privacy you will join a Global team that addresses the highest and emerging risks pertaining to how we manage, support, and respond to data incidents. You will work closely with Global Affairs, People Operations, Communications, Engineering, and other Investigation teams.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $252000 - $351000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead responses to data incidents. Consult on related regulatory inquiries, investigations, litigation, enforcement actions, and overlapping civil matters.
  • Oversee the collection and production of accurate information in external submissions and disclosures.

Minimum qualifications:

  • JD, LL.B., equivalent degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Admitted to the bar and in good standing or otherwise authorized to practice law (e.g., have registered in-house status) in the state in which the position is located.
  • 7 years of attorney-level experience in government, in-house, or at a law firm.
  • 7 years of experience with legal, regulatory and litigation matters, including addressing, minimizing, and avoiding regulatory risk.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with high risk incident response within internet or technology companies, including expertise in privacy, data security, or consumer protection subject matter.
  • Experience engaging with regulators, including State Attorneys General (AGs), Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Department of Justice (DOJ), and global data protection or consumer protection authorities.
  • Experience developing, evaluating, and maintaining programs that ensure products comply with laws, regulations, and external commitments.
  • Experience with managing projects and partnering with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with public company boards and their counsel, including special committees and audit committees.
  • Experience working with technology companies and ability to understand technical issues.

title: Detection and SOAR Engineer, Mandiant Consulting, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you will collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams like Mandiant Architects, Mandiant Analysts, Client Information Technology (IT) resources, and other business resource owners. You will be responsible for enabling the technology and tools required to effectively accomplish daily tasks within a Cyber Defense Center (CDC). This includes maintaining operational readiness of the client Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) platform, creating detection content and automations to support the daily tasks within the CDC. In addition, you may be responsible for setting appropriate configurations of the SIEM and SOAR or related response technologies required for a client's SOC to maintain effective incident detection and response capabilities.
Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Responsibilities

  • Identify challenges in customer Cyber Defense Centers (CDC) and formulate strategies for improvement, plan implementation of improvements, and execute/oversee plans to completion.
  • Advise on technologies relied upon by the client CDC, Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), and SOC.
  • Create and modify SIEM use cases written in both technology specific query language and Sigma open signature format. Create and modify SOAR playbooks written in Python.
  • Engage and collaborate with client stakeholders and other groups within customer environment to drive resolution for security issues.
  • Provide expertise for SIEM, SOAR and other SOC technologies that assist in incident response, and provide surge support for analyst T1-3 capabilities when required.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in detection engineering, SOAR automation, or a related role.
  • 3 years of experience working with SOC/CSIRT or other incident response related teams.
  • Experience with detection tuning and creation leveraging various security tools (e.g., SIEM, EDR, or NDR tools).
  • Experience with scripting Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions (e.g., writing queries, searches, alerts, dashboards) in Python or Powershell.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certifications in one or more of the following: CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+; CISCO (CCNA); ISC2 (CISSP); SANS (GSEC, GCIH, GCED, GCFA, GCIA, GNFA, GPEN).
  • Experience with SOAR and its dependencies, managing and maintaining SOAR platforms, as well as integrating APIs into automation playbooks.
  • Experience with content engineering inside SIEM platforms (e.g., rule creation, advanced correlation searching, etc.).
  • Experience with SPL, KQL, YARA-L or similar SIEM query languages, with an understanding of SIEM log flow, aggregation, and forwarding.
  • Understanding of logging for common platforms and devices, including Linux and network equipment.

title: Indonesian Language Manager
descriptionHtml:
In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

In this role, you have a passion for language and are responsible for shaping Google’s voice in Indonesia market and owning the localization quality and strategy for all Google products and contents localized for this market.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a good understanding of market expectations for localization quality and how Google's products fit in the market, and create language strategy to enable native language experience to users.
  • Be a critical partner for the Indonesia-focused teams with stakeholders in Marketing, Product and PR to enable native language experiences for Google’s products for Indonesian users.
  • Engage regularly with local stakeholders (Marketing, PR and product teams) to understand their priorities, and share updates on language strategy and global localization services.
  • Create and evolve Indonesian language guidelines and language strategy for Google, taking into account input from users, stakeholders, and tech language industry trends.
  • Develop an understanding of the Indonesia market and user expectations for Indonesian language quality and how to use language to achieve market needs. Propose language studies and user insights to ever-improve this understanding.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience within creative, localization, translation, journalism, public communications or the online marketing/advertising industry.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience utilizing AI technologies, specifically in validating AI output (e.g., Human-in-the-Loop) or developing AI-based quality programs.
  • Proficient in leveraging Generative AI to optimize localization quality processes and scale high-quality, culturally resonant content, coupled with a deep understanding of LLM limitations regarding linguistic/cultural nuance, bias, and factual accuracy.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the Indonesian linguistic and cultural landscape, including digital trends, pop culture, and local consumer behavior.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across businesses and leadership levels.

title: Student Researcher, PhD, Fall 2026
descriptionHtml:
The Student Researcher Program fosters academic collaborations by hiring students onto research projects aligned to company priorities in scientific advancement. The program offers placements on teams across Google, for research, engineering, and science roles. As a Student Researcher, you will have the opportunity to participate in research projects focused on developing solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

Student Researcher projects are exploratory and experiences that drive scientific advancement across a multitude of research areas. Students will work collaboratively on projects that explore innovative research challenges and support the creation of breakthrough technologies.

Projects vary in duration and location based on team and student requirements. It is required that you are located in one of the specific country locations identified for this role for the full duration of the engagement. When you apply, you will be considered for Student Researcher positions across all of Google's research teams including Google DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud and more. This allows us to find the right project match for your skills and interests.

Researchers across Google are working to advance the state of the art in computing and build the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we invest in foundational research and work on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Whether we're shaping the future of sustainability, optimizing algorithms, or pioneering AI systems, our teams strive to continuously progress science, advance society, and improve the lives of billions of people.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $118,000-$157,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in research to develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science, Linguistics, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Natural Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in one area of computer science (e.g., Natural Language Understanding, Human Computer Interactions, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Quantum Information Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or similar areas).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program and returning to the program after completion of the internship.
  • Currently attending a degree program in the United States.
  • Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.
  • Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in major conferences or journals.
  • Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, C/C++, etc.).

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, thấu hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và chuyển hoá những nhu cầu đó thành các giải pháp hiệu quả, giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội ngũ bán hàng để cùng gặt hái thành công, góp phần định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo ra những tác động thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược cho ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng tại Việt Nam, bạn sẽ là đối tác chiến lược và cố vấn đáng tin cậy cho các nhà phát triển trò chơi và ứng dụng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam, giúp họ mở rộng quy mô và gặt hái thành công trên phạm vi toàn cầu. Bạn sẽ quản lý và thắt chặt các mối quan hệ ở cấp điều hành, định hình cách Google hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ này trên toàn cầu.

Nhiệm vụ cốt lõi của bạn là bứt phá tăng trưởng kinh doanh cho khách hàng bằng cách tận dụng Chiến dịch quảng cáo ứng dụng của Google, hệ sinh thái ứng dụng trên khắp các dòng sản phẩm (bao gồm cả Google Play và các giải pháp Sellside), đồng thời khai thác các cơ hội đổi mới giữa các sản phẩm để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh vượt trội và có thể đo lường.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Hợp tác và tư vấn cho các khách hàng tại Việt Nam với mục tiêu cùng phát triển chiến lược kỹ thuật số, tăng cường kiến thức và mức độ sử dụng sản phẩm, nâng cao hiệu quả quảng cáo của khách hàng và phát triển hoạt động kinh doanh.
  • Xây dựng kế hoạch kinh doanh chung cho các tài khoản khách hàng quan trọng và giúp tạo bước ngoặt tăng trưởng thông qua việc thấu hiểu về mục tiêu kinh doanh, chỉ báo hiệu suất chính và các vấn đề.
  • Phân tích xu hướng dữ liệu và hiệu suất của khách hàng để đưa ra thông tin chuyên sâu về ngành, phối hợp với các phòng ban liên ngành để xác định những hướng đi chiến lược tiếp theo, đồng thời chuẩn bị và thực hiện các bài thuyết trình và chào hàng mang tính bứt phá.
  • Xây dựng nghiên cứu điển hình về các chiến dịch để chia sẻ thông tin chuyên sâu với khách hàng, cũng như để tham gia các sự kiện và hội nghị chuyên ngành.
  • Phát triển và duy trì các mối quan hệ với đội ngũ quản lý cấp cao, đóng vai trò là một đầu mối liên hệ với khách hàng và tư vấn về các xu hướng kỹ thuật số.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo kỹ thuật số, tư vấn bán hàng, phát triển kinh doanh hoặc tiếp thị kỹ thuật số.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để phục vụ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong ngành trò chơi/ứng dụng, truyền thông, phát triển kinh doanh, tiếp thị hoặc tư vấn bán hàng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm và đạt được thành công trong việc phát triển và duy trì những khách hàng được quản lý có giá trị cao, phức tạp theo hướng chiến lược thông qua phương pháp tư vấn.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Có khả năng vận dụng những cách tiếp cận sáng tạo để phát triển giải pháp qua dữ liệu.
  • Có kỹ năng tổ chức, giải quyết vấn đề, tạo sự ảnh hưởng và thuyết trình xuất sắc.

title: Data Center Facilities Technician, Mechanical
locations: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for the data centers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and mechanical system components.
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) and control and monitoring systems.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new mechanical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of mechanical/HVAC experience in an industrial or commercial environment.
  • Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in maintenance of mechanical/cooling distribution systems or construction/technical environment or a related field.
  • Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
  • Knowledge of mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., chillers, air handling units, pumps and CRAC/CRAH units).
  • Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

title: Head of Sovereign, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Key Account Executive (KAE) for the Public Sector, you will serve as a partner to Public Sector accounts related to different public entities across Ottawa. You will manage account growth strategies, engaging customers with consultative value selling methodology. You will drive long-term revenue growth by gaining an understanding of customers critical issues and aligning them with Google Cloud's portfolio of solutions. You will lead the end-to-end sales process, from initiating customer conversations to orchestrating internal and external teams to deliver revenue commitments and increased consumption. You will advocate the innovative power of products and solutions to make organizations more productive, collaborative, and mobile.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Canada: $182000 - $186000 (CAD) + 150% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue growth by developing and implementing sales strategies, building trusted consultative relationships, and leveraging emerging technology trends, market analysis, and cloud solution expertise to demonstrate Google Cloud's transformative value to customers.
  • Manage and track the sales pipeline, from lead to close, ensuring health and accurate forecasting for clear visibility into expected outcomes.
  • Negotiate multi-year contracts and formulate persuasive proposals that illustrate clear return on investment through customer business cases and comprehensive deployment plans.
  • Mobilize internal experts (Customer Developing, Partner, Post-Sales) and external partners at the right time to drive consumption and deliver a seamless customer experience.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in quota-carrying cloud or software sales, or consultative account management at a Business-to-Business (B2B) software company.
  • Experience working with the public sector market (e.g., federal government/defence and security entities) across Canada.
  • Experience engaging and building relationships with a wide range of internal teams and customer stakeholders.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle (e.g., pipeline management, forecasting, reporting) and managing commercial negotiations and agreements.
  • Candidates must hold or be eligible to obtain a valid Personnel Security Clearance as a condition of employment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with consultative selling to the public sector, asking questions, presenting proposals, and building multi-year account strategies.
  • Experience qualifying leads and presenting the value proposition against customers’ business opportunities and showcasing current technology trends and Google Cloud differentiators.
  • Experience expanding accounts, securing customers, and accelerating revenue and leading cross-functional teams and partners to co-sell and win.
  • Experience with agreement structuring, negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements, and supporting multi-year engagements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and partners in project implementation and negotiation.
  • Experience in the public sector. Ability to communicate in English and French fluently for regional support.

title: Social Agency Manager, LCS France (English, French)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €86000 - €88000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Engage and influence key decision-makers, including C-suite executives, building trusted relationships to understand their core business challenges and strategic priorities.
  • Lead the development of Joint Business Plans, aligning with customers on ambitious goals and establishing shared accountability to unlock transformative growth opportunities.
  • Design and pitch powerful, data-driven Google solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging in-depth knowledge of Google’s advertising offerings and compelling storytelling, while effectively navigating objections to secure investment and exceed revenue sales targets.
  • Demonstrate Google's value clearly by measuring campaign results against customer objectives and competitor’s offerings, and sharing data-driven insights that shape customer strategies and reinforce the partnership.
  • Own the customer's growth trajectory by proactively identifying and cultivating a robust pipeline of new opportunities, leveraging insights and proven success to expand the partnership.

title: SoC Power Architect, Google Cloud, Silicon
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a Power Architect, you will not just design chips; you will define the energy efficiency of the infrastructure that powers Google services worldwide.

In this role, you will be at the intersection of architecture, logic design, physical implementation, and system software. You will own the power architecture for next-generation custom System on Chips (SoCs), making critical trade-offs between performance, thermal constraints, and power delivery to build the most efficient computing platforms on the planet.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the SoC power architecture, including complex power domains, clocking structures, and power delivery network (PDN) solutions to achieve optimal performance-per-watt.
  • Architect sophisticated power management policies, including dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), power gating, and state strategies. Define the hardware/software interface for the Power management unit (PMU) and provide power management specifications.
  • Lead collaboration across architecture, RTL, physical design, packaging and validation teams to establish power budgets and specifications. Ensure power requirements are met from concept to tape-out.
  • Develop high-fidelity power and performance models to evaluate architectural features early in the design cycle. Drive pre-silicon power estimation and analysis to guide design decisions.
  • Lead post-silicon power analysis, correlating lab measurements with pre-silicon models to close the loop and improve future methodologies.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in ASIC/SoC architecture or design with a focus on power optimizations.
  • Experience developing or using power and performance modeling tools to drive architectural trade-offs.
  • Experience in low-power design techniques (e.g., UPF/CPF, multi-voltage islands, power gating, clock gating, etc.) and on-chip power management IP.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in the design and analysis of full-chip power integrity, including interactions between clocking, reset, and power sequencing.
  • Experience with post-silicon bring-up, power calibration, thermal management, and debugging in a lab environment.
  • Experience with data center or server SoC power architecture and management requirements.
  • Experience with industry-standard EDA power tools (e.g., Conformal LP, Power-Artist, PrimeTime-PX, Joules) and simulation environments.
  • Familiarity with modern workload analysis (AI/ML, transcoding, networking) and their impact on SoC power profiles.

title: SoC and IP Design Engineer, Networking
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will join an IP and subsystem design team building foundational custom silicon for Google Cloud, rather than focusing solely on standalone block coding or chip-level assembly, blends Register-Transfer Level (RTL) micro-architecture with complex IP and subsystem integration. You will architect and implement custom wrappers, bridges, protocol adapters, and control, interrupt, and debug infrastructure to integrate third-party vendor IPs and internal blocks such as high-speed Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) subsystems into cohesive, production-ready designs.

You will help modernize how we build silicon beyond RTL development, create and refine scripting and design automation flows that streamline large-scale IP assembly, configuration, and sign-off, while actively adopting and shaping advanced AI-powered and agentic workflows across hardware design, integration, and debug. You will partner closely with architecture, verification, physical implementation, Design for Test (DFT), software, and external IP vendors, you will drive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) trade-offs from initial specification through silicon bring-up.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Define IP and subsystem micro-architecture specifications, including interface protocols, block diagrams, clocking and reset schemes, register maps, and transaction flows.
  • Integrate complex third-party vendor IPs and internal blocks (such as PCIe subsystems), developing custom SystemVerilog RTL wrappers, glue logic, and protocol adapters.
  • Execute RTL quality sign-off and debug across functional and performance simulation, Lint, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), Reset Domain Crossing (RDC), Formal Verification, and Unified Power Format (UPF) checks.
  • Build and enhance design automation, RTL assembly tooling, and AI-assisted hardware engineering workflows to accelerate integration velocity and design quality.
  • Collaborate with architecture, verification, physical design, DFT, firmware, and external IP vendors on synthesis, timing and power (PPA) closure, coverage analysis, and ASIC silicon bring-up.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in digital logic design and RTL development using Verilog or SystemVerilog.
  • Experience with IP integration, subsystem design, or System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture.
  • Experience with logic synthesis, timing closure, and low-power design techniques.
  • Experience with RTL quality and sign-off tools (e.g., Lint, CDC).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience integrating third-party vendor IPs (such as controllers and PHYs), owning RTL wrappers, timing constraints, UPF, DFT handoffs, and vendor deliverables.
  • Experience with PCIe architecture and subsystem integration, or related interconnects and protocols such as Compute Express Link (CXL), Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe), or Advanced Extensible Interface (AXI).
  • Experience developing scripts, RTL assembly automation, and Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows (e.g., Python, Tcl).
  • Demonstrated eagerness to adopt and pioneer AI-driven tools and workflows across hardware design, integration, and debug.

title: Software Engineer III, Site Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Technical Program Manager II, Capacity and Constraints Management, Google Data Center
descriptionHtml:

Working across Data Center Facility Engineering, Construction, Network Architecture, CAD/BIM Spatial Modeling, Supply Chain, and AI/ML New Product Introduction (NPI) teams, you will translate high-density compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, structural, and optical network fabric requirements into production-ready server hall rack layouts, manage in-flight design changes, and apply AI-enabled automation to accelerate regional capacity delivery.The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. descriptionHtml:
