title: Partner Forward Deployed Engineer, Strategic Partners, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within partners for our customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic partners, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams.
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a team lead and developer within the strategic AI partner for AI applications, working with partner’s teams to transition from rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Co-build with a strategic AI partner’s own FDE teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring project success and high end-user adoption.
  • Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long-term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers.
  • Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 10 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience in customer facing role, engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of Large Language Model native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, Research Interns work on challenges in artificial intelligence, machine perception, data mining, machine learning, natural language understanding, privacy, computer architecture, networking, operating systems, storage and data management, and more. You are also expected to contribute to the wider research community by publishing papers.

Team Specifications:
Google’s Core Organization builds the foundational systems, technical frameworks, and platforms that power Google products worldwide. Within Core, our overarching mission is simple yet profound: to make Google work better for everyone at scale. Within Core, the Privacy, Safety, and Security (PSS) organization is dedicated to keeping everyone safe at scale—protecting billions of users, safeguarding their data, and securing Alphabet and the broader internet ecosystem. We operate on the principle that products must be secure by default and private by design.

Our research teams bridge the gap between theoretical computer science and planetary-scale engineering. We bring together researchers and engineers across cryptography, adversarial machine learning, privacy-preserving computation, systems security, and trustworthy AI. As a Research Scientist in Core PSS, you will pursue foundational and applied scientific breakthroughs—investigating emergent threat vectors, developing next-generation privacy and safety primitives, and creating mathematical and empirical guarantees that redefine digital safety. You will collaborate closely with core engineering hubs to translate novel proofs-of-concept into production deployments safeguarding billions of global users, while maintaining active contributions to the scientific community through first-tier publications, open-source initiatives, and academic partnershipsGoogle is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in research to develop solutions for problems.
  • Research, conceive, and develop AI/ML solutions to accelerate.
  • Contribute to deeper understanding of limitations of AI/ML architectures, trade-offs and optimizations.
  • Lay down the next steps for adoption of the research into next generation product development.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science and Engineering, Machine Intelligence and Data Science, AI or a related technical field.
  • Experience in one or more areas of Machine Learning (e.g., Large Language Models, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Computer Vision, etc.).
  • Experience programming in Python, Java.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program and returning to the program after completion of the internship.
  • Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.
  • Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals.
  • Experience with one or more of AI/ML frameworks.
  • Experience with security-related research, systems, or technologies.
  • Ability to design and execute on research agendas.

title: Technical Program Manager, Data Center/Construction
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Finland: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a large construction site and delivery organisation, managing scopes related to construction projects or capital improvement projects.
  • Be responsible for ensuring the development of detailed designs, managing construction (delivery, cost, quality and EHS), commissioning, close-out and hand-off to the operations team. Ensure all customer requirements are being met.
  • Establish and maintain various delivery models and global relationships with multiple vendors.
  • Create a growth plan and be involved in hiring/recruiting of talent in the areas of project management, field engineering, document control, technical writing, etc.
  • Research and implement construction means and methods of data center equipment and facilities. Carry design concepts into mass production and integrate into facilities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Construction Engineering, Construction Management, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in project and construction management.
  • Experience with commercial contract management and procurement.
  • Experience in electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Experience managing construction projects, within an international working environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with (data center) equipment/environments (including switchgear, generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, controls, security monitoring systems, fire safety systems), with an understanding of start up/commissioning processes.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, with an understanding of standard practices in the design and construction industry.
  • Ability to build excellent relationships and deliver on action-orientated tasks.
  • Ability to communicate in Finnish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

title: Strategic Alliance Manager, Security, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

Our mission is to accelerate Google Cloud Securityadoption and drive long-term partner growth by cultivating a high-impact ecosystem of partners. We empower our partners to deliver transformative solutions by aligning Google’s innovative technology with partner expertise. Our team is dedicated to fostering deep cross-functional collaboration, driving sustainable revenue results, and setting the industry standard for how we scale and succeed through partnership.

As a Security Strategic Alliance Manager, you will embed Google’s Security suite of products with Partner’s existing go-to-market strategy. Joining experts in cloud computing, big data, machine learning and cybersecurity, you will help build out the next generation of security intelligence solutions. You will be responsible for developing engagement with our strategic Security Service Providers, Telcos, GSIs, and Cloud Partners. You will collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management and will be responsible for achieving strategic goals, developing security sales, and driving partner success.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Own the process of growth acquisition through selected partners to meet assigned goals, selling to partner accounts and facilitating business opportunities after the initial sale.
  • Develop and execute on business plans that provide consistent year over year business growth in selected partner accounts.
  • Maintain a consistent set of Sales, Technical and Marketing benefits to partners that will facilitate their growth.
  • Build connections with Sales Managers and Partner Solutions to drive partner attach in all accounts.
  • Provide strategic input on business opportunities, agreement discussions, market announcements, and executive decision-making. Drive consensus on outcomes that balance both value and risk.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with foundational cloud technologies (e.g., network, compute, database, middleware, visualization, etc.).
  • 6 years of experience with partner/channel pipeline development and management, and Go-to-Market strategies.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree.
  • 2 years of experience presenting to multiple audiences including leadership and C-suite teams with excellent communication skills.
  • Experience with Security Operations (SecOps) toolset including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), Threat Intelligence and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.
  • Channel experience, with an understanding of the Google Cloud Partner Ecosystem and the role of partners in cloud transformations.
  • Knowledge of System Integrators (SIs), Service Providers (SPs), and Independent Software Vendors (ISVs).
  • Ability to present to executive-level audience, deliver Go-To-Market strategies/results, and partner with industry, partners, etc.

title: Product Support Manager, gUP Google Store and Fi
descriptionHtml:
In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's various product ecosystem. Additionally, we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

The gUP Platforms and Devices Google Store sits at the intersection of global e-commerce, hardware logistics, telecom, and generative AI. What makes us unique is that our Product Support Managers do not just manage queues, we architect automated systems, shape commercial and fraud policies, and power flagship Made by Google hardware across twenty plus markets.

In this role, you will own end-to-end purchase and post-purchase customer journeys, driving AI self-service transformation, replacement and repair modernization, and automated risk and refund workflows. You will care deeply about data-driven root-cause elimination by reducing Repeat Contact Rates and resolution times as embedded partners with Store, Fi, Engineering, Logistics, and Fraud teams.

As a Product Support Manager, you will lead post-purchase support operations, automated refund workflows, and ecosystem across Google Store and Health and Home. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Reverse Logistics, and Global Vendor Operations, design scalable agent workflows, govern Return Merchandise Authorization and order exception policies, and drive bug resolution Service Level Agreements to reduce customer effort, prevent financial leakage, and lower operational metrics.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $114000 - $163000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage post-purchase support across Google Store journeys, including order management, refunds, returns, replacements, and device protection.
  • Drive automation and workflows with engineering and operations to reduce customer effort, Repeat Contact Rate, and resolution time.
  • Analyze customer insights and metrics to identify product, policy, or tooling gaps and advocate upstream fixes.
  • Lead cross-functional escalation pathways, bug SLAs, and operational playbooks to resolve high-impact issues rapidly.
  • Ensure launch and ecosystem readiness across hardware portfolios, subscriptions, agent enablement, and fraud controls.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in a project management or a customer-facing role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in e-commerce, consumer hardware, post-purchase order management, refunds, returns, and device protection programs.
  • Experience designing and scaling automated workflows and self-service solutions to reduce customer friction and operational metrics.
  • Experience managing complex multi-quarter projects independently, influencing product, engineering, and supply chain partners.
  • Experience establishing operational playbooks, bug resolution service level agreements, and fraud mitigation guardrails in fast-paced support environments.
  • Strong analytical capabilities utilizing dashboards and root-cause analysis to translate customer insights into product and policy improvements.

title: Associate Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
As an Associate Legal Counsel on the EMEA Ads Legal team, you will sit at the intersection of commercial agreement-making, innovative ad technology, and European digital regulation.

In this broad commercial and advisory role, you will draft and negotiate a wide variety of agreements powering Google’s Ads, Analytics, and Commerce business across EMEA—spanning enterprise analytics and measurement partnerships, agency and advertiser incentive programs, and channel partner ecosystems.

Beyond transactional work, you will advise business and product teams on regional product launches and help translate evolving UK and European regulations (including English contract law, data protection/GDPR, AI, and competition rules) into practical, scalable and customer-facing solutions. Working closely with sales, product, and Global Affairs colleagues across EMEA and the US, you will build streamlined legal processes and provide pragmatic advice that helps the business grow at scale.

20th century laws don't always solve 21st century problems, and Google Legal crafts innovative approaches for working with some of the toughest legal challenges of the information age. Whether you're a patent attorney, an intellectual property expert or an engineer headed to law school, Google Legal lets you address unanswered legal quandaries and create new precedents. Our innovative services raise challenging questions that demand creative and practical answers. We provide those answers by working at the crossroads of the law and new technology, helping Google build innovative and important products for users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Review, draft, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements with advertisers, agencies, and partners across EMEA and maintain scalable templates and playbooks that comply with company policies and local law.
  • Develop deep expertise in Google’s Ads, Analytics, and Commerce products, partnering closely with sales, product, and business clients across EMEA and the US to structure and launch new commercial initiatives and product features.
  • Advise executive management, business clients, and Global Affairs colleagues on complex agreement structures, commercial risks, and the application of company policies and English law.
  • Advise on the interpretation and practical application of UK and European laws and regulations affecting digital advertising, ensuring scaled compliance across our products and commercial frameworks.
  • Drive continuous improvement across the team’s operations by designing streamlined processes, self-service guidance, and scalable contracting and compliance solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • JD, LL.B., equivalent degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Qualified solicitor in the UK.
  • 3 years of legal experience in private practice or in an in-house legal team in the UK.
  • Experience in contract, commercial, intellectual property, and IT/technology law, along with advising on data protection and privacy issues (e.g., UK/EU GDPR; ePrivacy Directive).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in the online advertising, digital media, or technology sector.
  • Experience reviewing, negotiating, drafting, and advising clients on complex, multi-jurisdictional technology and commercial agreements.
  • Knowledge of privacy, consumer protection, antitrust, contract, content moderation/safety, or IP law issues in a technology context.
  • Ability to design and deliver streamlined, efficient, and impactful contracting projects and commercial programs at scale.
  • Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects to deadline in a changing environment.
  • Ability to work on a broad range of legal matters, including UK and European digital, AI, privacy, and competition regulations affecting online advertising.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Gen AI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production, including solving data readiness and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white-glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop to shape Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customers' live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience managing technical discovery sessions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Director, Operational Technology Security
descriptionHtml:
Google's Data Center Compliance, Strategy, and Risk Management (CSRM) team is integrated across all stages of the data center lifecycle. CSRM is dedicated to protecting the people and assets of Google’s global critical infrastructure. By leveraging advanced security systems, dedicated guarding forces, and risk management and compliance frameworks, CSRM supports the entirety of Google Data Centers (GDC), enabling Google Cloud to reach a broader audience and inspire user trust.

As the Director of Data Center Operational Technology (OT) Security, you will define and execute the global direction, strategy, and governance for securing Google’s physical and operational data center infrastructure. You will lead a high-impact organization responsible for proactively identifying, quantifying, and mitigating complex enterprise-wide cyber and physical threats across critical systems. Serving as a strategic executive partner, you will align cross-functional leadership across Technical Infrastructure, Cloud CISO, and engineering organizations to build next-generation secure architectures, drive industry standards, and safeguard Google Cloud’s global footprint at scale.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $256000 - $356000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define and direct multi-year security architectures, risk quantification models, and defense-in-depth frameworks for global OT systems, rack-level environments, and critical facilities.
  • Establish governance mechanisms and executive accountability across GDC, Cloud CISO, Corporate Engineering, and PSS to deliver unified, end-to-end security architectures.
  • Build, scale, and inspire a global organization of technical managers, engineers, and program leaders. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, psychological safety, and leadership.
  • Serve as the principal advisor to business and engineering executives on emerging OT, cyber, and infrastructure threats, steering multi-year roadmaps and investment strategies to proactively protect critical assets.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience in technical infrastructure, industrial control systems (e.g., ICS/SCADA), or cyber security engineering, including 7 years of experience in executive leadership, managing teams.
  • 15 years of experience leading technical security programs, risk governance, or critical infrastructure engineering organizations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (e.g., Master’s degree or PhD) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related technical discipline.
  • 20 years of experience leading enterprise-scale OT, ICS/SCADA, and cyber security initiatives across global industrial or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Executive experience deploying zero-trust or defense-in-depth models across large-scale physical/cyber infrastructure environments.
  • Ability to navigate high ambiguity, drive organizational change, and deliver high-impact security outcomes across complex hardware and software ecosystems.
  • Recognized thought leadership in emerging OT security standards, liquid-cooling hardware integration, and threat-modeling frameworks.

title: Director, Gemini Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we are conducting AI research that advances the state-of-the-art and applying it to products so everyone can access AI. Google’s mission is to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful, and AI is helping us do that in exciting new ways.

As the Director of Product Marketing for the Gemini App, you will set the multi-year global product marketing vision and strategy for Google's AI assistant across mobile, web, and ecosystem integrations to build a product that helps everyone unlock their potential.

You will lead a multi-layered product marketing organization and partner with executive leadership across Product, Engineering, Design, Brand, Growth, and Communications to shape the product roadmap, define category positioning, and lead global go-to-market execution that drives adoption and business growth.

This role will sit directly in Mountain View with the Gemini product leadership team.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $264000 - $366000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leadership to shape the multi-year Gemini App roadmap, grounding product strategy and prioritization in deep user, market, and competitive insights.
  • Influence early product definition, naming, user experience, and launch sequencing to ensure new capabilities deliver clear, differentiated user value.
  • Use deep knowledge of AI products and trends to ensure that new Gemini capabilities deliver clear, differentiated value that leapfrogs competitor offerings. Define global audience segmentation, category positioning, and value propositions for Gemini App across consumer and prosumer segments.
  • Lead global go-to-market strategy and execution across major product launches and evergreen campaigns. Establish GTM measurement frameworks to track funnel performance, brand impact, and ROI.
  • Partner with Product Design and Growth leadership to align storytelling with the in-product onboarding and discovery experience, driving sustained feature adoption.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 15 years of experience in product marketing or consumer technology marketing, driving measurable brand and business outcomes.
  • 10 years of experience in senior leadership roles building and managing multi-layered marketing teams and influencing executive product roadmaps.
  • Experience partnering with VP and C-level cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Design, Brand, Communications, and regional teams.
  • Experience leading global, end-to-end go-to-market strategy and launches for flagship consumer technology products at multi billion user scale.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with the rapidly evolving generative AI landscape, enabling the strategic foresight to guide product innovation, anticipate market shifts, and foster a culture of continuous AI experimentation and adoption within the marketing organization.
  • Experience connecting outbound brand and product marketing with in-product user journeys and growth mechanics to drive full-funnel adoption.
  • Proven ability to coach senior leaders, elevate organizational talent, and align complex cross-functional organizations around shared business goals.
  • Track record of translating complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling consumer positioning and category-defining product launches.

title: Kỹ sư phụ trách về chất lượng sản phẩm, mảng Đồng hồ và Tai nghe
descriptionHtml:
Tham gia đội ngũ tiên phong chịu trách nhiệm phát triển các giải pháp silicon tuỳ chỉnh để định hình tương lai cho các sản phẩm Google phân phối trực tiếp tới người tiêu dùng. Bạn sẽ đóng góp vào quá trình cải tiến để tạo ra những sản phẩm được hàng triệu người trên toàn thế giới yêu thích. Kiến thức chuyên môn của bạn sẽ góp phần định hình thế hệ trải nghiệm phần cứng tiếp theo, mang đến hiệu năng, hiệu suất và khả năng tích hợp vượt trội.

Với vai trò Kỹ sư phụ trách về chất lượng sản phẩm, bạn sẽ dẫn dắt toàn bộ quá trình triển khai chất lượng sản phẩm giữa các nhóm nội bộ và nhà sản xuất/nhà cung cấp theo hợp đồng. Bạn sẽ tạo cầu nối cho quy trình chất lượng, từ kiểm tra trực quan cơ bản đến thiết kế tiên tiến chú trọng chất lượng và khả năng sản xuất bằng cách tận dụng dữ liệu có độ trung thực cao nhằm đảm bảo sự hài lòng của khách hàng.

Trong vai trò này, bạn sẽ hợp tác với các phòng ban liên ngành, bao gồm quản lý sản phẩm, thiết kế, kỹ thuật hệ thống, vận hành và chuỗi cung ứng để xây dựng tư duy chủ động và phòng ngừa, thúc đẩy văn hoá không ngừng cải tiến và hướng đến việc tăng quy mô sản xuất có thể dự đoán được và ra mắt sản phẩm mà không gặp sự cố.

Sứ mệnh của Google là hệ thống hoá thông tin của thế giới và giúp thông tin đó trở nên hữu ích và dễ tiếp cận trên toàn cầu. Nhóm Thiết bị và Dịch vụ của chúng tôi kết hợp những điểm ưu việt nhất trong công nghệ AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google, nhằm mang lại trải nghiệm hữu
ích về mọi mặt cho người dùng. Chúng tôi nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ cùng phần cứng mới để người dùng có thể tương tác với công nghệ điện toán một cách nhanh chóng, mạnh mẽ và liền mạch hơn. Nhóm Thiết bị và dịch vụ đang làm cho cuộc sống của mọi người
trở nên tốt đẹp hơn thông qua công nghệ, bất kể bằng việc tìm kiếm cách mới để nắm bắt và cảm nhận thế giới xung quanh, cải tiến kiểu dáng sản phẩm hay nâng cấp phương thức tương tác.

Responsibilities

  • Dẫn dắt các Kế hoạch chất lượng sản phẩm (PQP) nhằm chuyển trọng tâm từ việc kiểm tra trực quan cơ bản sang "thiết kế dựa trên dữ liệu để đảm bảo chất lượng và khả năng sản xuất", đảm bảo phạm vi kiểm tra chất lượng và khả năng phát hiện phù hợp.
  • Hợp tác với bộ phận kỹ thuật trong giai đoạn Ra mắt sản phẩm mới (NPI) để xác thực ý định thiết kế (Phân tích dung sai), đảm bảo khả năng mở rộng và tối ưu hoá thông số kỹ thuật bằng dữ liệu có độ trung thực cao.
  • Sử dụng phương pháp Thiết kế thử nghiệm (DOE) và Kiểm soát quy trình thống kê (SPC) để đảm bảo rằng các quy trình sản xuất luôn ổn định và có khả năng vượt trội (CpK >1,33).

title: Software Engineer III, Performance
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our team is delivering state-of-the-art performance on OSS models to showcase the capabilities TPUs, to both in industry competitions and to optimize these models so our public customers can leverage the optimization recipes in their own models.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Write product or system development code. Manually optimize models, using state-of-the-art techniques (sharding, quantization, custom kernels).
  • Develop principles from manual optimizations which can be automated via agentic AI (e.g., compute, communication, scheduling, or quantization cost models).
  • Land identified principles and recipes to build scalable solutions, for example, by collaborating with the compiler team on cost modeling or by building agentic tooling for headroom analysis.
  • Create scalable solutions to serve the third-party customer base by improving out-of-the-box software performance and open-sourcing tooling to external customers.
  • Develop trend analysis to identify performance issues in yet-unseen models, solving performance problems before they occur. While maintaining model benchmarks to ensure tracking of performance wins.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 2 years of experience with computer architecture, performance analysis, and performance modeling.
  • Experience experimenting with AI agents or LLM-powered agentic workflows.
  • Experience in systems engineering.


Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • Experience with low-level accelerator programming (e.g., CUDA, Triton, Pallas) and performance tuning techniques.
  • Experience with machine learning, compiler optimization, code generation, and runtime systems for GPU architectures (OpenXLA, MLIR, Triton, etc).
  • Debugging experience to improve performance of single-mode or multi-mode (distributed) systems.
  • Expertise in tailoring algorithms and ML models to exploit ML accelerator architecture strengths and minimize weaknesses.
  • Deep understanding of modern ML accelerator architectures (Nvidia/AMD GPUs, TPUs, Trainium, Cerebras, etc.), memory hierarchies, and performance bottlenecks.

title: Technical Program Manager II, Hardware NPI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

title: Product Design Engineer, Pixel Hearables
descriptionHtml:
The Google Pixel Hearables team focuses on designing and delivering the world's most helpful wearable experience. The team works on shaping the future of Pixel devices and services through some of the most advanced designs, techniques, products, and experiences in consumer electronics. This includes bringing together the best of Google’s artificial intelligence, software, and hardware to build global hearables and create transformative experiences for users across the world.

As a Product Design Engineer, you’ll design the next generation of Pixel Earbuds. You will drive the design, analysis, and prototyping of new concepts while working in a manufacturing and product-oriented development environment. You demonstrate creative problem solving and design skills, clear communication, and a solid base of engineering fundamentals. Your strong organizational skills help you manage your varied responsibilities across the product. You will work on a Product Design team that balances comfort, performance, and appearance in an innovative and harmonious design that complements and enables the technology. You’ll collaborate with external vendors and internal cross-functional teams such as Electrical Engineering, Antenna, Industrial Design, Reliability, Operations, and Audio to define and deliver excellent products.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design a complex subsystem or multiple moderately complex individual parts from concept to production.
  • Collaborate with suppliers of subsystems or individual parts throughout the design and manufacturing process.
  • Identify the root cause of design, manufacturing, or reliability issues and develop corrective actions.
  • Balance design considerations such as functionality, sustainability, reliability, human factors, manufacturability, and aesthetics.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience designing mechanical components such as plastic or metal parts, mechanical assemblies, printed circuit boards, or flexes.
  • 3 years of experience using computer-aided design (CAD) tools such as 3D MCAD, NX, Creo, or Solidworks.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of work experience in consumer product design.
  • Experience shipping multiple consumer products.
  • Experience collaborating with suppliers around the world on part manufacturing and final assembly, including onsite factory support.
  • System integration experience, including electro-mechanical components (audio, display, camera, antenna, etc.), waterproofing, thermals, grounding, or product architecture.
  • Experience with multiple manufacturing methods used in consumer products.

title: Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure, Core
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design, write, and deploy production-grade code for multi-agent workflows, tool-use orchestration engines, and dynamic decision-making pipelines.
  • Deploy AI frameworks and tools, to enable velocity in product development and scalability of agentic applications that require high-precision and safe execution under complex real-world conditions.
  • Build robust, high-throughput model serving pipelines and real-time execution environments optimized for latency, reliability, and scale.
  • Integrate continuous, data-driven feedback loops into AI development methodologies. Construct automated testing, continuous evaluation, and observability frameworks to assess agent coverage, monitor regressions, and safeguard product quality across end-to-end workflows.
  • Adopt and integrate distributed tracing, data lineage architectures, and telemetry (e.g., OpenTelemetry) into high-volume generative AI data pipelines.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in Java.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  • 1 year of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs,
    Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).
  • Experience in machine learning infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 1 year experience in machine learning, generative AI and AI algorithms.
  • 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Platforms Security
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Defend the security firmware and hardware foundation of the world’s most critical infrastructure.

The Platforms Security team builds hardware and firmware roots of trust protecting Google’s fleet against sophisticated threats. In this role, you will:

  • Build the foundational layer: Deploy authenticated Roots of Trust and trusted execution environments into data center silicon.
  • Engineer resilience: Scale cutting-edge firmware, drivers, and reliability platforms across millions of machines.
  • Shape standards: Represent Google within open-source initiatives like OpenTitan, Caliptra, and OCP.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive technical strategy for hardware security across Google's fleet, leading transitions to open-source Roots of Trust (Caliptra, OpenTitan) and Post-Quantum Cryptography readiness.
  • Co-design secure architectures with hardware teams, deploying critical software, firmware, and utilities for custom security chips, BIOS, and OS kernels.
  • Connect bare-metal/RTOS systems (Rust/C, SPI, I2C) with fleet-wide cryptographic services, including CA operations, attestation, and credential binding.
  • Represent Google in the hardware security ecosystem, driving community roadmaps and implementations for standards like OpenTitan, Caliptra, and TPM.
  • Guide distributed teams through complex, high-impact deliverables from conception to deployment. Elevate engineering standards through modern CI/CD, automated hardware-in-the-loop testing, cross-functional alignment, and proactive mentorship of junior and mid-level engineers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 7 years of experience working with embedded operating systems.
  • 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products.
  • Experience with Embedded Systems, Security Standards and C, C++, and Rust.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
  • 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (IT-Infrastrukturtechniker), AI Infrastructure

title: Part-Time Research Scientist PhD Intern, 2027
descriptionHtml:
Research happens at Google everyday, on many different embedded teams throughout the company. Our research reaches the user through both services and products such as Search, Maps, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, and our computing, storage, and networking infrastructure. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible. At Google, research-focused engineering interns are embedded throughout the company, contributing to the setup of large-scale tests and deploying promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, research-focused engineering interns work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and more.

Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in research to develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.
  • Research, conceive, and develop software applications to extend and improve on Google's product offering.
  • Contribute to a wide variety of projects utilising natural language processing, artificial intelligence, data compression, machine learning, and search technologies.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field in Israel, and in your penultimate/final year of education.
  • Experience in one or more Research areas; Natural Language Understanding/Processing, Computer Vision, LLMs, Machine Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, AI/ML Algorithms, Deep Learning or Image Processing, multimodal, multilingual and reinforcement learning.
  • Experience and profiency in one or more general purpose programming languages: Java, C++, Python, or Go.
  • Experience with research from previous internships, full-time industry experience, personal projects, lab work, or published papers (being listed as author).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals.
  • Ability to design and execute on research agendas.

title: Staff Software Engineering Manager, YouTube
descriptionHtml:

Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. title: Technical Program Manager, GSRS, Physical Security
descriptionHtml:
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.

In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness. You will be responsible for completing initiatives that improve Google’s ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act on security risks globally. You will drive delivery of physical security technology solutions in scope of the Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) organization. You will partner internally to prototype and develop solutions on accelerated timelines against stakeholder requirements, owning the full end to end delivery and support of those solutions throughout their lifecycle. Your delivery will enable GSRS operations to keep Google and Google employees safe and secure across the global office locations.

Responsibilities

  • Provide mentoring and guidance for junior colleagues, peers and stakeholders as a subject matter expert in physical security towards shared business goals and objectives.
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of deployed solutions, gathering feedback and iterating to improve user experience and outcomes.

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:
