title: Technical Program Manager II, Integrated Infrastructure Planning, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Build and operate an integrated infrastructure planning capability that covers the 0-10 year horizon, transforming product demand, infrastructure constraints, and financial objectives into actionable capacity decisions and a unified infrastructure Plan of Record.

As a Capacity Planner, you will help translate evolving product demand into actionable infrastructure capacity plans across compute, storage, network, data center, and other infrastructure resources. You will work with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and Planning teams to integrate demand, capacity constraints, planning assumptions, and investment decisions into a coherent infrastructure Plan of Record.

In this role, you will have an opportunity to build a broad understanding of hyperscale infrastructure while contributing directly to how Google plans capacity across multiple time horizons.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Execute recurring and scenario-based infrastructure capacity planning across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and Planning organizations.
  • Analyze product demand, infrastructure requirements, capacity constraints, deployment alternatives, planning assumptions, and dependencies to identify gaps, tradeoffs, and planning risks.
  • Help develop, reconcile, and publish the infrastructure capacity Plan of Record, ensuring approved demand and capacity decisions are accurately reflected in authoritative planning outputs.
  • Partner with Engineering and Planning teams to translate product demand into infrastructure requirements and reconcile planning outputs across compute, storage, network, data center, and supply-chain domains.
  • Prepare clear planning analyses, executive materials, and recommendations that enable timely infrastructure decisions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience analyzing datasets using spreadsheets, SQL, Python, business intelligence tools, or similar analytical technologies.
  • Experience in capacity planning.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience developing dashboards, planning models, metrics, or data-driven decision-support mechanisms.
  • Experience working with planning systems, data pipelines, workflow automation, or structured sources of truth.
  • Experience with supply chain, operations research, forecasting or technical planning.

title: Creative and IMA Partner Delivery Manager, gTech Ads Agency and Partners

title: Software Engineer, AI/ML, PhD, Early Career, 2026
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. We are responsible for designing and managing the software, hardware, and Machine Learning (ML) systems infrastructure that power essential Google services such as Search and YouTube, as well as Google Cloud products.

As a PhD Software Engineer within AI2, your specialized research expertise will be instrumental in solving complex, real-world problems on an unprecedented scale. You'll engage in innovative projects spanning areas like AI/ML, networking, data storage, security, and distributed systems.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. descriptionHtml:

title: Senior CPU Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will work as part of a Research and Development team. You will build verification components, constrained-random testing, and system testing, and drive verification closure. You will verify digital designs, collaborate closely with design and verification engineers on projects, and perform direct verification. You will build constrained-random verification environments that exercise designs through their corner-cases and expose all types of bugs. You will manage the full life-cycle of verification, which can range from verification planning and test execution to collecting and closing coverage.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Plan the verification of digital design blocks by fully understanding the design specification and interacting with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
  • Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM, or formally verify designs with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and industry leading formal tools.
  • Identify and write all types of coverage measures for corner-cases.
  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
  • Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with creating and using verification components and environments in standard verification methodology.
  • Experience verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for FPGAs or ASICs.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Product Engineer, Global Manufacturing Engineering
descriptionHtml:

The Manufacturing Operations team is responsible for providing the manufacturing capability to deliver this state-of-the-art physical infrastructure. As a Manufacturing Engineer, you evaluate the product designs and create the processes, tools and procedures behind Google’s powerful search technology. When vendors build parts for our infrastructure, you’re right there alongside ensuring manufacturing processes are repeatable and controlled. You collaborate with Commodity Managers and Design Engineers to determine Google’s infrastructure needs and product specifications. Your work ensures the various pieces of Google’s infrastructure fit together perfectly and keep our systems humming along smoothly for a seamless user experience.

As a Product Engineer for Global Manufacturing Engineering, you will design, build, optimize, and deploy manufacturing requirements for Google’s compute infrastructure at global partner sites. You will partner with New Product Introduction (NPI) teams to define Design for Manufacturing (DFM) requirements and provide critical input into manufacturing test strategies. Your role involves providing high-caliber sustaining engineering support for both new and existing products, while driving initiatives to enhance test process efficiencies, expand test coverage, and ensure supply continuity with multi-sources strategy. You will proactively analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve manufacturing yield issues, bonepile management as well as data center field escapes, implementing corrective and preventive measures. By collaborating with internal and partner engineering teams, you will drive continuous improvement, ensuring hardware quality and performance excellence.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with NPI teams to establish Design for Manufacturing (DFM) requirements and optimize test strategies for global compute infrastructure.
  • Provide end-to-end product engineering support to ensure operational stability across both new and legacy hardware platforms.
  • Drive initiatives to expand test coverage, streamline manufacturing throughput, and lower overall production costs at partner sites.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for manufacturing yield fallout and data center field escapes, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Collaborate with internal and external partner engineering teams to continuously enhance hardware quality, system performance, and operational efficiency.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent engineering experience.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Ecosystems, Frontier AI, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:

You will understand how frontier research breakthroughs can be translated into ecosystems of open AI systems and creating an impactful two-way flywheel between the global open-source community and Google’s core foundation models like Gemini and Gemma. You will help research teams navigate technical, safety, and ecosystem tradeoffs, build collaborations with core model development teams, and partner with Google product areas (such as Cloud, Android, Pixel, and Search) as well as external developers, enterprises, academic researchers, and public-sector institutions to address real-world needs across on-device AI, sovereign and regulated workflows, scientific discovery, and societal benefit. In addition to shipping open-weight model variants, training recipes, and interactive environments, you will build the developer tooling, open-source runtime integrations, and communication strategy so that our open AI systems achieve widespread adoption and set the industry standard.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

descriptionHtml:

They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

As a Rapid Response Manager on the YouTube Trust and Safety team, you will be responsible for ensuring that our policies are enforced effectively end-to-end, including from the point of identification of possible violation, to removal and appeals. You will work with cross-functional teams to provide YouTube’s response to emerging escalations. You will review graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.

This role will require on-call work on weekends and holidays on a rotational basis.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $141000 - $205000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, ensuring global operational readiness for major events, emerging crises, and high-impact incidents.
  • Manage end-to-end policy escalations by actively triaging, investigating, resolving, and tracking complex cases through specialized internal tools and tracking systems and evaluate cross-product, high-severity escalations to assess regulatory risk, operational impact, and required enforcement actions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on YouTube’s Community Guidelines, manage related escalations, and drive policy and process improvements across multiple policy areas.
  • Build cross-functional product expertise to accelerate resolution times, collaborating with Engineering partners to build preventative tooling and conducting rigorous postmortems to stop future systemic failures.
  • Review graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and YouTube Partner Program policies and draft and review executive communications, partnering cross-functionally to land sensitive policy decisions regionally.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in data analytics, Trust & Safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with international issues across multiple geographies, including child safety or online controversial content.
  • Experience in driving operational efficiency and process management.
  • Experience working with cross-functional partners (e.g., Engineering, Legal, Product) to drive execution or resolve crises.
  • Strong communication skills to drive consensus across stakeholders.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, rapidly-changing industry and tolerate ambiguity while seeking to minimize uncertainty through quantitative insights.
  • Strategic and analysis skills, including the ability to lead a team to frame problems, structure analyses, and drive to impact.

title: Regional Manager, Google Cloud, Government Affairs and Public Policy
descriptionHtml:

You will serve as Google Cloud's representative to state policymakers, government executives, IT decision makers, and key third-party groups in your markets. A crucial aspect of this position is working with Google Cloud stakeholders to support business growth and public policy objectives at the state and local levels, proactively addressing both risks and opportunities. You will also engage with key trade associations vital for advancing Google Cloud’s public policy, infrastructure and business goals.Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Data Center Facilities Engineer, Electrical (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Engineer, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting electrical systems of industrial facilities.
  • 2 years of Electrical experience (e.g., electrical testing equipment or electrical distribution) in an industrial or commercial environment.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, holidays, and on shift-based schedules.
  • Ability to communicate in English orJapanese fluently to work with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certification related to data center facilities (e.g., CDCP, CDFOM, or AOS).
  • Experience in performing maintenance on critical electrical systems (e.g., generators, UPS systems, ATS/STS units).
  • Understanding and working experience in complex mission-critical facility environments, including data centers, hospitals, production factories, etc.
  • Understanding of multiple disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, control and generator systems used in a data center environment.
  • Ability to communicate in Japanese (JLPT N2 level or equivalent) and English (TOEIC 730+, Eiken Grade 2, or equivalent) fluently to work with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Data Center Technician II
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.
  • Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Persistent Disk – IPU, Storage Offloads
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As a Senior Software Engineer for the IPU Storage Offloads team, you will design and implement the low-level software and firmware that powers Google’s next-generation Infrastructure Processing Unit (IPU). You will focus on the Persistent Disk (PD) data path, enabling high-performance NVMe emulation, hardware compression/decompression, and hardware-accelerated cryptography.

You will bridge the gap between ASIC capabilities and core block-storage services to deliver unprecedented Input/Output Operations per Second (IOPS) and latency metrics while guaranteeing end-to-end data integrity and confidentiality.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop low-level drivers and kernel-level modules.
  • Develop embedded C++ services running natively on ARM CPU cores to manage storage queues, ring buffers, and Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe)/Direct Memory Access (DMA) controllers.
  • Optimize the data-path for microsecond-level latency and millions of IOPS using advanced hardware features like physical doorbells and direct cache routing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of software development experience in C or C++ with a focus on systems programming.
  • Experience with low-level systems architecture: PCIe, DMA, IOMMU, memory-mapped I/O (MMIO), and interrupt handling.
  • Experience debugging on pre-silicon or early bring-up platforms using hardware emulators (e.g., P3, CSS models) or physical logic analyzers/JTAG.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with custom SoC storage virtualization technologies (e.g., NVMe/SCSI controller emulation, VirtIO).
  • Familiarity with storage data protection protocols, including block cryptography and data integrity validation (logical block addressing (LBA) mapping, cryptographic hashes).
  • Understanding of hardware-level security architectures.

title: Firmware Software Engineer Manager, Pixel
descriptionHtml:

The Modem Reliability Engineering (MRE) team within Pixel Test Engineering is responsible for end-to-end cellular reliability, quality, performance, and modem software delivery across the Google Pixel portfolio. Operating at the intersection of embedded modem firmware and live global carrier networks, MRE drives protocol/RF validation, field testing strategy, carrier technical support and certification, deep protocol debugging, and AI-powered test tooling transformation to deliver seamless connectivity experiences for Pixel users worldwide.

The Platforms and Ecosystems product area encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications). The products provide enterprises, and ultimately end users, the ability to utilize and manage their services at scale. We build innovative and compelling software products—from apps to TVs, from laptops to phones—that have an impact on people’s lives across the world.

Responsibilities

  • Define technical direction, test strategy, and roadmaps for Pixel modem firmware (5G NR, LTE, NTN/Satellite, IMS/VoNR/VoWiFi, NAS/AS, RF/L1) across global networks and vendors to balance launch targets with platform quality.
  • Lead distributed engineering and vendor teams through field verification cycles (functional, performance, mobility, reliability, stress, carrier certification) to ensure commercial software quality.
  • Transition manual testing to scalable, AI-driven automation—modernizing test harnesses, Key Performance Indicator (KPI) collection, cloud data pipelines, and log triage to enhance velocity and cost efficiency.

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

descriptionHtml:

Preferred qualifications:

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Developer AI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product road map. You will embed with the engineering organizations of our largest customers and take Google's developer AI Gemini Code Assist, anti-gravity Integrated Development Environment (IDE), Software Development Kit (SDK), Command Line Interface (CLI) and the agentic surfaces beneath them from the first conversation to a production-grade workflow. You will find what actually slows an engineering organization down, design the system that fixes it, and own it end-to-end like discovery, build, roll-out, hardening, and the long tail of making it reliable.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

title: Applied AI and ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

At Google, data drives all of our decision-making. As part of the Finance Data and AI (DnA) team in the CFO organization, our focus is on building secure, scalable, and intelligent solutions that transform financial operations.
In this role, you will lead the technical strategy, design, and deployment of end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic solutions to transform legacy Finance processes into AI-native workflows. You will not just build models; you will design autonomous, self-correcting agentic systems that partner with Finance Googlers to drive unprecedented efficiency across Google's Finance organization. You will operate at the intersection of advanced ML and Agentic tools to design, develop and deploy large-scale solutions for various Finance processes like Accounting, Finance Operations, financial planning and analysis, etc.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the technical design of multi-agent workflows, utilizing a toolkit (ML and Gemini LLMs) to solve complex, multi-layered financial problems.
  • Build, prototype, and scale end-to-end AI agents. Collaborate with senior developers to build robust system architectures that prioritize reliability, usability, and auditability—ensuring clear human-in-the-loop interfaces for finance professionals.
  • Take prototypes from isolated testing environments to scaled production systems. Collaborate with senior developers to design and deploy high-availability model endpoints with robust health checks, error handling, retries, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Implement rigorous evaluation frameworks and guardrails to eliminate logical errors, hallucinations, and biases in automated financial decision-making.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a PhD degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Engineering, Sciences).
  • 1 year of experience building agentic systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 4 years of experience using analytics to solve product problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a relevant PhD degree.
  • Experience working in a financial, audit, or highly regulated domain where deterministic accuracy and auditability are paramount.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing and deploying AI or ML models and utilizing modern observability/monitoring tools to track performance, latency, model drift.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical architectures and probabilistic model behaviors.
  • Strong command of classical ML modeling (e.g., time-series forecasting, tree-based models) alongside modern LLM/Generative AI tooling.

title: Research Engineering Manager, Responsible Frontier AI Research, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of Research and Software Engineers in our Responsible Frontier AI Research team. Your team will build the engineering foundations of DeepMind's Responsibility research portfolio. This includes automated platforms that discover, measure, and mitigate jailbreaks, and red-teaming tools used by subject-matter experts across DeepMind. It also includes defenses that help AI agents operate safely on the open web, and evaluations and tools that facilitate mitigations for severe harms, such as chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) risks and harmful manipulation, as part of our Frontier Safety Framework.

Because the responsible AI landscape shifts quickly, you will need to be a highly adaptable leader who can step into any of these research areas, build context fast, and direct engineering effort where it matters most. You will balance research experiments with robust, scalable infrastructure that other teams rely on. You will also combine technical leadership with hiring, developing, and retaining an exceptional team.

You will be joining a specialized Applied Research and Responsibility team within Google while closely partnering with teams across DeepMind, Research, Product, and Policy to identify and address key issues in responsible AI. Our work remains deeply integrated with DeepMind.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate priorities for multiple workstreams that support the broader responsibility organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams, and move engineering capacity between research projects as priorities change.
  • Set clear expectations with individuals, including tech leads, based on their level and role. Meet regularly to discuss performance and development, provide feedback and coaching, and hire and grow a high-performing team.
  • Develop the long-term technical goal and roadmap within, and often beyond, the scope of your teams, covering systems such as evaluation pipelines, red-teaming tools, autoraters, and mitigation training pipelines. Evolve it as frontier models become more capable, agentic, and multimodal.
  • Oversee system designs and review code to solve ambiguous problems. Set best practices for code quality, scalability, reliability, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Partner with Research Scientists, Subject-Matter Experts, and Product, Program, Policy, and Trust and Safety teams to turn research into evaluations and mitigations that inform model launch decisions. Present trade-offs and results to senior leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience leading teams working on AI safety, security, or responsible AI research (e.g., adversarial robustness, red teaming, safety evaluations, or mitigation's for frontier models).
  • Experience with one or more of the following: automated red teaming or jailbreak discovery, LLM-based autoraters and evaluation design, safety classifiers or probes, prompt injection and agent security, or evaluation of severe-harm risks such as CBRN or Harmful Manipulation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with a focus on adversarial machine learning or AI/ML security.
  • Track record of research or engineering achievements, such as publications in peer-reviewed venues, open-source projects, or public benchmarks.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, AI/ML Expert for Agents and TrustGraph, Google Ads
descriptionHtml:

Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. The Agents and TrustGraph (ATG) team is a broad, cross-cutting horizontal organization spanning Ads Privacy and Safety, Consumer Trust and Safety, and partner Product Areas across Google. We build the foundational AI platforms, relational intelligence infrastructure, and adversarial crawling systems that protect Google’s users, advertisers, and publishers from bad actors.

As online abuse and fraud grow in volume and sophistication—increasingly powered by generative AI—static rules and reactive manual workflows are no longer enough. Because ATG operates as a horizontal pillar with Google-wide fan-out, engineers on our team are not siloed into a single narrow product. Instead, you will have the flexibility to work across projects and pivot to where the highest leverage lies.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex issues. Join us to work on AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

descriptionHtml:

D is the foundational layer of Google’s storage stack. It is a low-level storage system that stores bytes directly to disk or flash and serves the majority of Google’s data. It is the critical mediation layer between higher-level storage systems and data center management facilities.

We're looking for engineers to help us build and scale this critical distributed control plane. You'll get to rethink how storage capacity is provisioned, isolated, and made available at Google scale.

This is an exciting time in the evolution of Google's core storage architecture, as we strive to maximize the utilization and efficiency of our storage resources fleetwide. By improving how we balance load, manage failure domains, and automate device lifecycles, you'll directly impact the reliability and cost-effectiveness of Google's global storage infrastructure.

title: Associate Principal, Trust and Safety, Shopping
descriptionHtml:
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

In this role, you will work hard to earn the users’ trust every day. Gaining and retaining this trust is critically important to Google’s success. You will defend Google's integrity by fighting spam, fraud and abuse, and develop and communicate state-of-the-art product policies. The Trust and Safety team reduces risk and protects the experience of the users and business partners in more than 40 languages and across Google's expanding base of products. You will work with a variety of teams to set policies and combat fraud and abuse in a scalable way. Trust and Safety team members are motivated to find innovative solutions, and use technical know-how, user insights and proactive communication to pursue the highest possible quality and safety standards for users across Google products.

Trust & Safety (T&S) Shopping team mission: Deliver safe and trustworthy shopping experiences to all users.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities

  • Ideate and manage high impact projects which increase user safety, or improve user experience, in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Perform investigative fraud and abuse analysis, producing actionable insights and recommendations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with multiple cross-regional and cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Content Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Search Content Platforms' mission is to understand and organize the world's content to power the best Search+ experiences, enabling disparate sources and modalities of content accessible and connected.

In the first decade, Google’s mission was to organize web content and connect users to information via 10 blue links. In the next decade, we built an answer engine and a rich set of domain-specific, immersive (vertical) Search experiences. Now, we offer an AI-forward, multimodal information experience, leveraging broader content availability and the advances in AI capabilities to harvest and organize our content.The mission is to build a content platform that uses AI to minimize or eliminate the effort for both content providers to share their content with Google, and vertical teams to expose the content to users.
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

Minimum qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience with extract, transform, and load (ETL), data architecture, and system integration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

title: Data Center Mechanical Engineer

From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Product Manager, Customer Incentives and Growth Platforms
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Product Manager on the Incentives and Growth Platforms team, you will own the end-to-end product goal, technical strategy, and execution for core customer incentive and reward charters across the customer lifecycle. You will manage complex challenges at the intersection of behavioral economics, growth engineering, conversational AI, recommendation engines, partner platforms, and fraud/risk. This is a high-visibility role where you require strong product instincts, technical depth, and the ability to rally cross-functional stakeholders (Engineering, UX, Product Marketing, Data Science, Operations, and Risk) around a clear product point of view and infrastructure.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central product leader uniting cross-functional partners—including Software Engineering, UX/Design, Product Marketing, Customer Operations, Data Science, and Trust and Safety/Risk.
  • Lead the proactive use of AI tools and reasoning models to conduct deep quantitative and market research, analyze user journeys, test behavioral hypotheses, and rapidly prototype novel incentive mechanics and conversational workflows.
  • Own the multi-quarter strategy and technical roadmap for core customer incentive and reward charters, aligning product bets with broader business growth, customer retaining, and payback goals.
  • Design robust MCP tool schemas and API interfaces that empower autonomous agents and conversational assistants to deliver personalized promotional recommendations.
  • Design and execute rigorous A/B testing and flighting strategies to evaluate hypotheses, measure causal incrementality, and analyze redemption vs. breakage economics.

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
  • Experience in customer incentive platforms, promotional engines, loyalty/rewards systems, billing/fintech, growth engineering, or business generation mechanics.
  • Experience managing ambiguity, proactively anticipating technical or operational roadblocks, and turning complex platform constraints into seamless customer experiences.
  • Practical proficiency in leveraging generative AI tools and agents for deep product research, market synthesis, user journey mapping, and rapid feature prototyping.

title: Policy Escalation Specialist, YouTube Trust and Safety (Bahasa Indonesia)
descriptionHtml:
Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.

As a Policy Escalation Specialist, you'll ensure that we deliver performance goals for sensitive and timely escalations of potentially questionable content. You will manage the response to these escalations globally and use a variety of tools, communications, and facilitation methods to ensure that issues are triaged and the right stakeholders are involved in resolution. As part of this role, you will also help test new processes, systems, and infrastructure to manage escalations, while also contributing input into where we put our efforts next. Additionally, you will dig into the data around incidents and search for trends, impact, and possible improvements.

In this role, you will be required to work on-call on weekends and holidays on a rotational basis.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

  • Manage escalations, with a focus on the Indonesia market, as part of the APAC Headquarters team in the Trust and Safety organization.
  • Review and manage escalations including graphic and controversial video content, in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.
  • Ensure that all escalations are triaged, tracked, investigated, resolved and communicated accurately using internal tools and systems. Manage or assist in conducting reviews to capture lessons-learned and ensure regular follow-up for any items identified.
  • Analyze, identify, prioritize, and deliver operational improvement opportunities. 
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define the best plan for resolving escalations and implement fast.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, content policy/review, anti-abuse, data analytics or related fields.
  • Ability to communicate in Bahasa Indonesia fluently in order to review content and manage escalations with content in these languages.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours (including on-call rotations, evening and overnight hours), weekends, holidays, and shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in driving operational efficiency and process management.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, solve problems, and thrive in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Ability to use data to drive strategy and business action.
  • Ability to build relationships with cross-functional partners across geographies.

title: Data Center Facilities Technician Intern, 2027
descriptionHtml:
Behind Google’s simple search box is one of the most complex technology infrastructures in the world. And behind that infrastructure is a group of Googlers, who design, build, and keep the lights on for our users. Our Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future, and our technicians, engineers, and support teams bring ideas to life. The teams use creative approaches to reduce operational costs and to extend traditional practices to meet our goal of making our data centers the most energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable in the world.

As a Data Center Facilities Technician Intern, you will play a vital role in maintaining the physical data center environment. You will train alongside experienced technicians, gaining experience by assisting with the operation, maintenance, and repair of critical electrical and mechanical systems, including HVAC, UPS, generators, and control and monitoring systems.

A key part of your role will be learning to inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems like piping and other electrical or mechanical components. You'll also learn to read blueprints and schematics, assist in conducting system tours, and provide daily support to our technicians. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to develop creative solutions for improving operational efficiencies and reducing costs, all while adhering to our strict health and safety policies. By learning our systems and tools, you will build a solid technical foundation and grow your skills in a mission-critical environment.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Strategic Partner Manager, Payments Platform
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Controller, GRAS Business Controllership
descriptionHtml:
Google accountants are a savvy bunch who handle the core accounting responsibilities at Google. You know your accounting principles and the full accounting process end to end. You'll advise on financial reports required by governmental regulations, and review, analyze, and interpret financial and budgetary reports. Every day is a new challenge, and you're continually looking for ways to help our team become more efficient and effective. As a Senior Controller for the GRAS (Geo, Revenue, Ads, Search) Business Controllership team, you will act as a trusted guardian and dedicated finance partner for key Google products. You will navigate complex accounting topics and deeply understand underlying business operations to translate product and agreement requirements into clear accounting guidance. You will advise on controllership frameworks and ensure a seamless to the core accounting teams for downstream execution, balancing business growth with financial integrity and risk mitigation.

And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Network Delivery Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. title: Kỹ sư quản lý chất lượng sản phẩm, Nhóm Phần cứng
descriptionHtml:
Tham gia đội ngũ tiên phong chịu trách nhiệm phát triển các giải pháp silicon tuỳ chỉnh để định hình tương lai cho các sản phẩm Google phân phối trực tiếp tới người tiêu dùng. Bạn sẽ đóng góp vào quá trình cải tiến để tạo ra những sản phẩm được hàng triệu người trên toàn thế giới yêu thích. Kiến thức chuyên môn của bạn sẽ góp phần định hình thế hệ trải nghiệm phần cứng tiếp theo, mang đến hiệu năng, hiệu suất và khả năng tích hợp vượt trội.Nhóm Nền tảng và Thiết bị bao gồm các nền tảng phần mềm điện toán khác nhau của Google trên nhiều môi trường (máy tính, thiết bị di động, ứng dụng), cũng như các thiết bị và dịch vụ do Google trực tiếp phát triển, kết hợp tối ưu AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google. Các nhóm trong lĩnh vực này nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ mới nhằm giúp người dùng tương tác với công nghệ điện toán nhanh và liền mạch hơn, đồng thời mang đến những trải nghiệm đột phá cho người dùng trên toàn thế giới.

Responsibilities

  • Xác định và triển khai các kế hoạch liên quan đến chất lượng sản phẩm xuyên suốt chu trình phát triển sản phẩm, đồng thời đảm bảo mọi bước trong chu trình được thực thi hiệu quả.
  • Xây dựng chiến lược và khung phát triển chất lượng cho Nhà sản xuất thiết kế chung (JDM). Quản lý các nguồn lực về chất lượng tại nhà máy, nâng cấp quy trình, hiệu suất và năng lực, kiểm định và triển khai, đồng thời thường xuyên đánh giá chất lượng nhà máy.
  • Quản lý quy trình báo cáo vấn đề lên cấp trên về chất lượng tại nhà máy, giải quyết các vấn đề liên quan đến chất lượng sản phẩm được phát hiện trong giai đoạn ra mắt sản phẩm mới (NPI) và sản xuất hàng loạt (MP). Quản lý quy trình phân tích lỗi tại nhà máy, đánh giá rủi ro, xử lý và triển khai các biện pháp cô lập/khắc phục/phòng ngừa.
  • Thiết lập các chỉ số chất lượng phù hợp. Thúc đẩy tiến trình thiết kế thử nghiệm (DOE) và thu thập dữ liệu kiểm soát quy trình thống kê (SPC) để đánh giá, kiểm định và xác minh chất lượng sản xuất của tất cả các nhà sản xuất và dòng sản phẩm theo thoả thuận.
  • Dẫn dắt quy trình quản lý thẩm mỹ cho sản phẩm và quản lý chất lượng vật liệu trong giai đoạn Lắp ráp hoàn thiện, kiểm thử và đóng gói (FATP).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân ngành Kỹ thuật điện, Kỹ thuật công nghiệp/sản xuất hoặc Kỹ thuật cơ khí hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực sản xuất thiết bị di động hoặc hàng điện tử tiêu dùng, cụ thể là các sản phẩm điện tử tiêu dùng liên quan đến màn hình, âm thanh, lớp phủ, công nghệ không dây, in trong khuôn cơ khí.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực phát triển chất lượng sản phẩm.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bằng thạc sĩ ngành Kỹ thuật hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 5 năm kinh nghiệm giám sát hoạt động cải thiện năng suất và rút ngắn thời gian hoàn thành chu trình sản xuất.
  • Kinh nghiệm ngăn chặn vấn đề suy giảm chất lượng ngay từ giai đoạn đầu trong quá trình phát triển sản phẩm, triển khai quy trình báo cáo vấn đề chất lượng lên cấp trên và liên tục cải tiến sản phẩm cùng các đối tác JDM.
  • Kinh nghiệm áp dụng các chỉ số chất lượng, nắm bắt quy trình phân tích hệ thống đo lường tối quan trọng của JMP, nâng cao phạm vi chất lượng đầu ra và triển khai các phương pháp hiệu quả, tiết kiệm chi phí.
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc với các hệ thống nhúng, xây dựng quy trình tạo bảng mạch logic kỹ thuật số và thử nghiệm hệ thống con không dây.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng tiếng Quan Thoại, tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để hỗ trợ việc quản lý quan hệ khách hàng ở khu vực này.

title: Software Engineer, Gemini App Skills Platform, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Join DeepMind’s mission to solve intelligence and benefit humanity by building the next generation of agentic AI. As a Software Engineer on the Gemini App Skills Platform, you will be a key contributor to the extensible execution layer that transforms Gemini from a conversational assistant into an action-oriented, universal agent.

In this role, you will architect the systems that allow Gemini to discover, retrieve, and execute modular capabilities (skills) across Google, DeepMind, and third-party ecosystems. Your work will bridge foundation model intelligence and real-world execution spanning dynamic context engineering (system instructions), low-latency routing algorithms, and automated evaluation frameworks. While this role focuses heavily on Large Language Model (LLM) behavior and evaluation, you will dive directly into Gemini app’s production serving infrastructure (primarily C++) and Python evaluation pipelines to make high-impact, hands-on architectural enhancements. You will have an opportunity to operate at the center of Google’s flagship AI product. You will see your code, prompts, and evaluation standards actively shape the user experience for hundreds of millions of users across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and Chrome, helping define how people and AI interact with software.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build intelligent skill discovery, hybrid routing architectures, and low-latency C++ serving components across Gemini on web, mobile, and Chrome.
  • Pioneer dynamic system instructions, prompt representations, and semantic retrieval schemas that enable Gemini to seamlessly navigate expanding skill catalogs without attention dilution or quality regressions.
  • Design automated evaluation frameworks (auto-raters, simulated environments, and benchmarking suites) to rigorously measure single-turn triggering precision, multi-turn tool, and parameter validity.
  • Perform in-depth loss analysis on production telemetry, drive iterative prompt/model hill-climbing to surpass quality thresholds, and set standards for system reliability and clean architecture across the organization.
  • Partner closely with DeepMind Research, Search, Vertical teams (e.g., local, shopping), and external Engineering teams to onboard new modular capabilities onto the platform.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience developing software with large language models, agentic workflows, tool use, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Experience designing evaluation datasets, automated rating systems, or conducting error analysis and prompt optimization for generative models.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally across research, product, and platform engineering teams to take novel AI features from prototype to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to design experimental setups, analyze model telemetry, and define reproducible metrics for complex features.

You will analyze the entire inference stack to identify critical bottlenecks and drive systemic improvements. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.


We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. title: Global Product Lead, YouTube Ads 3P Data Activation, YouTube Ads GTM
descriptionHtml:
The YouTube Ads GTM team is the link between YouTube and Google Ads products and business. Our mission is to fuel innovation that keeps YouTube and Google free and accessible to the world. We do this by translating global market needs into meaningful product solutions that drive business results for partners and customers. As part of the team, you'll help to ensure that Google has adopted the right strategy for our products and you'll use your expertise to help front-line Sales partners work their magic quickly and effectively.

The YouTube Ads Experience team in particular plays a vital role in improving the YouTube Ads experience throughout the marketing journey across planning, creating, buying and reporting. This team also empowers the 3P partner ecosystem with YouTube solutions and resources they need to be set up for success across our Ads platforms. With deep expertise in the partner ecosystem, API solutions, media and marketing processes, Generative AI, the complex internal and external creative ecosystem, and our sales organization, this team sits at the nexus of Google and YouTube’s API products, data strategy and sales strategy.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and lead global strategy and commercialization efforts for YouTube Ads API product suite across insights, planning, creative, buying and reporting.
  • Package API solutions and develop market-ready collateral to support API adoption. Build globally scalable programs to advance partner and advertiser adoption.
  • Drive operational excellence via sales and partner enablement initiatives including incentive design and building an API maturity framework within marketing certification programs.
  • Foster a cohesive feedback loop between partner teams and product teams on API services. Own the creation of all relevant sales documentation/collateral/training for the YouTube Ads API portfolio in service of meeting product and partner milestones.
  • Navigate complex and competing stakeholder POVs across regions, sales channels, GPS, Marketing, Product Management, UX and Engineering to drive actionable progress on YouTube Ads API strategy.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in advertising, marketing technology, management consulting, or product management.
  • 2 years of experience working with Product Management or Engineering teams, executive leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • 2 years of experience developing business strategies or managing cross-functional initiatives.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with agencies and partners.
  • Expertise in the creative development process and the creative ecosystem.
  • Knowledge of Google and YouTube’s ad solutions and value proposition in the market, with a specialization in creative ads products and generative AI.
  • Ability to drive and operate clarity in a fast moving and sometimes ambiguous space and navigate large, complicated organizations.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders and influence executive stakeholders and drive results without official authority.
  • Strong problem solving skills, including providing data driven, actionable insights to shape strategy and key decisions.

title: Industry Manager, Large Customer Sales
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google's Large Customer Sales teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more.

As an Industry Manager, you will lead on Google Portugal’s most sophisticated, and significant customers. You will leverage your understanding of the Advertising industry and Google's advertising solutions to help this client achieve their business objectives and drive meaningful growth in the dynamic digital landscape. You will require extensive experience in performance and brand solutions and a developed understanding of the wider engaged landscape. You have excellent influencing skills to navigate a business with various range of stakeholders.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Portugal: €72000 - €73500 (EUR) + 40% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and grow senior-level relationships in marketing with major customers as a trusted consultant to optimize their advertising. Manage existing stakeholder relationships and develop new ones across our clients' leadership and enterprise teams.
  • Generate and operationalize joint business plans to maximize mutual business impact through defined strategies.
  • Develop scalable and leading edge solutions for clients to optimize their advertising investment and maximize use of all Google AI solutions. Understand and adapt to Google's ongoing product and technology developments.
  • Manage multiple cross-product opportunities and projects, with a deep focus developing first class Demand Capture sales motions along with Brand/Consideration strategies for top tier clients.
  • Demonstrate Google's value by measuring campaign results against customer objectives and competitor’s offerings, and sharing data-driven insights that shape customer strategies and reinforce the partnership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of industry experience in advertising, consultative sales, business development and IT, or 3 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building relationships and business development with C-level executives.
  • Experience working with Google Ads and measurement solutions.
  • Experience public speaking in front of large audiences.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
  • Excellent project management, people management and organizational skills.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager in Google Networking Technologies Edge (GNT-Edge), you will be responsible for leading cross-functional project initiatives that span organizational levels to facilitate the delivery of New Product Introductions (NPIs), network architectures, delivering new hardware and software features, and the orchestration of network migrations.

In this role, you will require a highly credible thought leader within Google and the industry, possessing deep subject matter expertise in the organization's domain.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and initiate New Product Introductions (NPIs) in response to opportunities and needs, acting as the catalyst for gaining support and driving them to completion.
  • Collaborate with Google Networking Technologies (GNT) and Edge engineering teams to develop and articulate long-term strategy and short-term plans, creating roadmaps, engaging teams and engineers, and setting the development pace for software systems and infrastructure.
  • Drive project delivery, technology reviews, guide technical proposals, and build consensus across cross-functional teams.
  • Design and implement new process improvements and facilitate scaling for program teams. Contribute to improving Google's ability to deliver network capacity on time and with availability.
  • Deliver cross-functional projects/programs, ensuring customer value and managing Edge programs that include new NPIs, Edge architecture, and features/functions to deliver new services.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience managing the delivery of network technologies or services within network environments (e.g., service provider, enterprise, or cloud networks).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience with New Product Introductions (NPIs).
  • Experience developing and influencing long-term strategy and product roadmaps for network infrastructure or software systems.
  • Experience with network protocols and technologies common in service providers or enterprise edge networks (e.g., Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS), Segment Routing, Software Defined Networking).

title: Customer Developer, Cloud AI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
