locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người kiến tạo sự tăng trưởng chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, mang lại giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động nhằm thúc đẩy sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác. Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ vận dụng tư duy nhạy bén trong kinh doanh để xác định, định hướng và thu hút khách hàng bằng các giải pháp Hiệu suất dựa trên AI của Google (Tìm kiếm). Bạn sẽ cung cấp dịch vụ khách hàng, nghiên cứu và phân tích thị trường theo chuẩn của Google, đồng thời dự đoán cách đưa ra quyết định, thấu hiểu những điểm khác biệt tinh vi của từng chiến dịch, cũng như không ngừng tìm tòi và khám phá nhu cầu của các lĩnh vực kinh doanh chủ chốt. Cùng với khách hàng, bạn sẽ đặt ra mục tiêu và chiến lược để quảng cáo của họ có thể tiếp cận người dùng một cách hiệu quả nhất.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Duy trì mối quan hệ bền chặt với khách hàng, công ty quảng cáo và các bên liên quan trọng yếu khác để đảm bảo phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh và thúc đẩy hợp tác thành công.
  • Thiết kế và giới thiệu các giải pháp mang tính đột phá, dựa trên dữ liệu (Tìm kiếm dựa trên AI) phù hợp với nhu cầu của khách hàng. Tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và kỹ năng kể chuyện lôi cuốn để xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều, thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh thu.
  • Chỉ đạo thực thi các sáng kiến chiến lược để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng và tăng doanh thu cho các giải pháp hiệu suất dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), từ đó đổi mới hoạt động quảng cáo của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích và tối ưu hoá Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI) tiếp thị bằng cách theo dõi và đánh giá hiệu suất của các chiến dịch dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), đưa ra các đề xuất dựa trên dữ liệu để không ngừng cải thiện.
  • Nắm bắt các xu hướng và cải tiến trong ngành tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và đề xuất chủ động để đảm bảo đội ngũ và khách hàng luôn dẫn đầu trong bối cảnh không ngừng thay đổi.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc có kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo, tư vấn bán hàng hoặc phát triển kinh doanh.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh để làm việc với các bên liên quan trong nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm thúc đẩy thay đổi và phối hợp với nhiều bên liên quan.
  • Có kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên chức năng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong ngành trò chơi.
  • Có kinh nghiệm thiết lập mối quan hệ và bán hàng cho các bên liên quan ở cấp điều hành.
  • Am hiểu về các hoạt động và mô hình kinh doanh truyền thông liên chức năng.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Land Development Manager II, Data Centers
descriptionHtml:
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator, you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating deals, managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting deal recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every part of the business.

Within Infrastructure Construction and Asset Management (ICAM), the Data Center Land Development team stewards Google’s owned Data Centers and supporting infrastructure post-acquisition. We bridge the gap between raw land and construction, ensuring on-time capacity delivery by mitigating risk, securing complex land entitlements, and negotiating utility agreements to build a scalable real estate foundation.

As a Land Development and Portfolio Manager, you will partner with cross-functional teams to lead pre-construction development on owned sites. You will take ownership of land-use entitlements, finalize provider agreements, and coordinate off-site infrastructure to ensure sites operate on schedule, within budget, and at full capacity. Serving as the primary site lead from post-acquisition through asset end-of-life, you will cultivate vital relationships with local jurisdictions, utility partners, and engineering teams to drive long-term operational success.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Negotiate utility infrastructure and extension agreements (water, wastewater, gas, power, roads) with providers and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJs). Ensure third-party and company-delivered extensions are timely, cost-effective, and secured with firm capacity and protective terms.
  • Support civil, utility, and building construction programs by ensuring campuses are development ready and aligned with schedules. Coordinate zoning, entitlements, easement actions, environmental mitigations, permitting (air, discharge), and grid or traffic impact studies.
  • Serve as the lead liaison with local and national utility providers for supply strategy. Facilitate critical negotiations between internal technical teams and external partners to secure the utility capacity needed for planned data center developments.
  • Manage all development activities to consistently meet or exceed required infrastructure delivery schedules as determined and communicated by internal capacity planning teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Real Estate or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience of leading negotiations on land entitlements and infrastructure agreements on projects using a combination of internal and external resources.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Real Estate, or a related field.
  • Experience managing greenfield land development, site selection, and real estate transactions for data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience in agreement drafting, redlining, and delivering presentations.
  • Expertise in project economics, risk management, financial modeling, budgeting, indirect taxes, and economic development policy.
  • Track record of collaborating with utility providers and local governments to secure power allocations, with an understanding of power transmission and data center technology.

title: Software Engineer, Google Pay, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Work on Ask Google Pay, an AI Financial assistant for the Google Pay users. 
  • Work on AI agent features and eval platform, create skills, tools for new features on Ask Google Pay, and to improve engagement of the product.
  • Know about relevant technologies (e.g., Java, Dart, Flutter, Android/iOS, AI agent). 
  • Build scalable infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with mobile apps, full-stack, or backend development.
  • 2 years of experience with coding languages, like Java, etc.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or in a related technical field.
  • Experience with cross-team members to drive features end-to-end.
  • Experience building systems that scale to millions of users globally.
  • Experience building AI agents in a production environment.

title: Technical Program Manager III, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, Global Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

Integrated Capacity Group is the single orderer of compute and storage quota and the operator of shared and dedicated Flex resource pools across Technical Infrastructure, Core, Search, Platforms and Devices, Geo.We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end capacity planning, forecasting, and supply fulfillment for dedicated resources.

Unlike large shared pools where workloads statistically multiplex across tens of thousands of machines, dedicated security-isolated pools require tight cluster-level hardware planning across failure domains, machine platforms, data center power constraints, and cross-product area quota conversions.

In this role, you will build the forecasting and supply engine for these dedicated pools and specialty dedicated infrastructure. You will replace ad-hoc spreadsheets with automated demand models, translate multi-quarter service migrations into physical machine orders and shared-to-dedicated quota exchanges, validate power feasibility, and drive annual planning and budget escalations.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own the capacity forecast for dedicated machine pools across all global clusters, modeling organic growth, new cluster turnups, and large inorganic service migrations.
  • Translate logical resource demands into physical dedicated machine supply, ensuring every cell meets hardware platform rules and failure-domain minimums across switches and mzones.
  • Drive two supply fulfillment paths for dedicated pools, placing long-lead orders with power validation, and executing faster shared-to-dedicated machine conversions by transferring donor quota and coordinating drains.
  • Lead annual planning, allocation reconciliation, and the escalation cycle for specialty dedicated infrastructure orders.
  • Partner with Compute Security Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), Cluster Management TI Resource Managers (TIRMs), and migrating product area Product Area Resource Manager (PARMs) across Cloud, Core, Search, and Technical Infrastructure (TI) to unblock and onboard services without stocking out constrained clusters.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience with data analysis, business intelligence, or dashboarding tools (e.g., SQL or metrics platforms).
  • Experience with infrastructure capacity planning.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • 5 years of experience in technical program management, capacity planning, product area resource management, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience writing SQL queries and building data models or dashboards to analyze fleet utilization, demand forecasts, or supply-chain bottlenecks.
  • Experience translating software workload requirements such as compute, memory, local storage, and failure-domain redundancy into physical infrastructure capacity plans.

title: Regional Enablement Lead (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
The Japan Regional Enablement Lead (REL) acts as a partner to the Japan Office of the President, COO and Chief of Staff. You will be the critical link between global enablement strategy and regional execution, responsible for supporting the priorities across Japan.

In this role, you will balance the need for global consistency with the necessity of local relevance, ensuring that Cloud Googlers in Japan are equipped to lead with AI and execute our GTM priorities, accelerating performance through engaging and relevant enablement that contributes to impactful business outcomes and fosters a culture of excellence.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and execute the enablement plan. Act as a member of the Japan extended leadership team, providing a bidirectional feedback loop.
  • Drive daily usage and proficiency in tools like Gemini Enterprise and NotebookLM. Enable field sales representatives and customer engineers to move beyond technical features to deliver AI-first business narratives.
  • Lead Gemini Enterprise initiatives, tailoring global business assets into sessions that resonate with the Japan market and manager community of practice, focusing on coaching through uncertainty.
  • Deploy refresher resources that empower managers to help their teams create value narratives. Execute required learning through internal learning management systems.
  • Ensure that the region attains 80% or more completion of required courses. Translate and adapt global business plays into local market contexts to ensure relevance.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in management consulting, sales enablement, program management, or sales operations.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Japanese fluently for global collaboration with stakeholder engagement.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience taking broad global concepts and developing structured, localized plans for a regional field.
  • Experience guiding sales teams through organizational restructuring or role transformations.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud products or similar cloud technology platforms.
  • Ability to partner with the Japan leadership team to prioritize enablement interventions.

title: Product Manager, Search Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role you will own critical Search improvements that leverage the best of web quality to power next-generation AI experiences, including AI Answers and Overviews. You will work on the cutting edge of GenAI, defining product strategy and unlocking complex new use cases. This is a highly collaborative role where you will partner closely with Research, Search Quality, and cross-functional engineering teams. You will have direct ownership of model output evaluation, analyzing patterns, and translating user research insights into actionable product quality efforts.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define product strategy for key modeling capabilities and quality improvements that unlock new, complex use cases for AI Answers in collaboration with Research and Search Quality teams.
  • Lead direct model output and response evaluation, analyzing patterns and integrating user research insights to inform product quality prioritization.
  • Drive the development of measurement systems and autoraters to enable fast, continuous product improvement.
  • Navigate the complexities of the Generative AI and Search product landscape to build and ship technical products for billions of users.
  • Operate strategically in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving environment to facilitate the successful scaling of AI on Google Search.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 2 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
  • 2 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
  • 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
  • 1 year of experience in software development or engineering.
  • Knowledge of, or continued interest in building accessibility best practices, and experience/curiosity for incorporating accessibility into product development methodologies.

title: Senior GPU Performance Software Engineer, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another.   • 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • Experience with hardware/compiler co-design or high-performance computing (HPC).

  • Experience in GPU programming using CUDA or Triton kernels (or Palace/Mosaic kernels).
  • Background in Compiler optimizations or related fields would also be beneficial.

descriptionHtml:

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and carry out post-layout low power verification methodologies according to execution schedules and tapeout signoff criteria to ensure successful multi-voltage implementation.
  • Validate the implementation of complex multi-voltage design collateral, performing gate-level checks using industry-standard tools (e.g., Synopsys VCLP) to ensure power/ground integrity and Unified Power Format (UPF) alignment.
  • Drive the resolution of complex Physical Design and Place & Route (P&R) anomalies, specifically mitigating issues such as wrong domain buffering, secondary power routing failures, and isolation clamping errors.
  • Perform debugging on advanced Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) implementations, analyzing tool behavior around level shifters in high fanout networks, duty cycle distortions, and multi-voltage skew management.
  • Drive the continuous refinement of power state tables (PST) and Unified Power Format (UPF) scripts to ensure accurate translation from Golden RTL to the final physical netlist.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience performing post-layout physical netlist validation and low-power signoff within advanced ASIC design workflows.
  • Experience with static low-power rule-checking tools (such as VCLP or CLP), including experience in debugging structural checks and signal corruption issues.
  • Experience validating special low-power components (isolation cells, power switches, level shifters, retention registers, and always-on cells) across all stages from synthesis to place and route.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Tcl or Python) to automate Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and improve verification workflows.
  • Experience interacting with P&R tools (Innovus, Fusion) and an understanding of standard cell timing, hierarchical construction, and physical logic optimization.
  • Experience with UPF implementation, low-power architecture design, and resolving low-power check violations.
  • Expertise in resolving technical issues within the IEEE 1801 UPF framework and physical gate-level netlist flow.
  • Familiarity with timing-driven Place and Route, including insertion, scaling, level shifters, and always-on cells.

title: Data Center Operations Manager, Global Server Ops, Hardware Operations (English)
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

Your team will install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). They will also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. They may lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.

In this role, you will lead one or more teams to deliver critical data center initiatives (e.g., data security, machine maintenance, networking), identify trends via data analytics at the project level, and drive the changes needed to address them (e.g., improve tools, processes, or procedures). You will be the point of contact for escalation for one or more data center sites, quantifying systemic issues and escalating when appropriate. You will work with the partners (e.g., program managers, data center operations) to provide input into short-term and long-term strategy, process changes, and task orders for the site. You will manage projects to budget, timeline, and resourcing needs.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Belgium: €116000 - €118000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Direct and mentor a team of Data Center Technicians, setting clear expectations, guiding career development, and managing performance to foster high engagement and operational excellence.
  • Drive deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle operations across mission-critical compute, storage, high-density machine learning accelerators, and network infrastructure to consistently meet SLAs, SLOs, and key business KPIs.
  • Lead an uncompromising Environmental Health and Safety culture while enforcing rigorous compliance with Google data security standards, media chain-of-custody protocols, and incident investigations.
  • Manage workflow tracking and trend analysis to eliminate non-productive tasks, optimize labor utilization, and partner with engineering teams to influence automation and tooling improvements.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience.

  • Ability to communicate in English fluently to communicate with internal teams, local site staff, and external partners/authorities.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing technical operations in large-scale, mission-critical 24/7 data center environments or hyperscale cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing vendor contracts, statement-of-work (SOW) deliverables, and extended workforce operations.
  • Proficiency in operational analytics, workflow tracking, and metric-driven problem-solving (e.g., SQL, dashboards, labor utilization, capacity modeling).
  • Proven track record of driving Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) programs and fostering a safety-first team culture.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive data security compliance, media sanitization protocols, and chain-of-custody procedures.

title: Financial Accountant
descriptionHtml:
Google accountants are a savvy bunch who handle the core accounting responsibilities at Google. You know your accounting principles and the full accounting process end to end. title: Research Scientist, Neutral Atoms, Quantum AI
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

As a Research Scientist, you will be joining a team building a fault-tolerant quantum computer based on neutral atoms. You will be involved in research and development to advance the neutral atom quantum platform, translating theoretical concepts into practical experimental setups.

The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement hardware for a neutral-atom quantum computer apparatus.
  • Develop error-tailored architectures for quantum computing.
  • Enable hardware studies to develop accurate error models for neutral-atom physical operations.
  • Publish and disseminate your research findings.
  • Collaborate with quantum-error-correction experts at Google Quantum AI.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Physics or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • One or more scientific publication submissions for conferences, journals, or public repositories related to quantum.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 1 year of experience owning and initiating research agendas.
  • Experience in optical and mechanical design software.
  • Experience building neutral atom experiments.
  • Knowledge of computer science.
  • Ability to collaborate with theorists.

title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Applications
